import json
import sys

def find_duplicate_keys(file_path):
    with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    # Use a custom decoder to detect duplicate keys
    def check_for_duplicates(pairs):
        keys = []
        for key, value in pairs:
            if key in keys:
                print(f'Duplicate key found: {key}')
            keys.append(key)
        return dict(pairs)
    
    try:
        json.loads(content, object_pairs_hook=check_for_duplicates)
        print(f'{file_path}: No duplicate keys found')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{file_path}: Error - {e}')

import json
import sys

def find_duplicate_keys_detailed(file_path):
    with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    
    # Look for duplicate keys within the same object level
    current_object_keys = {}
    brace_count = 0
    current_level_keys = []
    
    for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
        stripped = line.strip()
        
        # Count braces to track nesting level
        brace_count += stripped.count('{') - stripped.count('}')
        
        # Check for key definitions
        if ':' in stripped and stripped.startswith('\"'):
            key = stripped.split(':', 1)[0].strip().strip('\"')
            
            # Check if we've seen this key at this level before
            level_key = (brace_count, key)
            if level_key in current_level_keys:
                print(f'Line {i}: Duplicate key \"{key}\" at nesting level {brace_count}')
            else:
                current_level_keys.append(level_key)
        
        # Reset keys when we close an object
        if '}' in stripped:
            current_level_keys = [k for k in current_level_keys if k[0] < brace_count]

import json
import sys

def check_for_duplicates(file_path):
    with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    def detect_duplicates(pairs):
        keys = []
        duplicates = []
        for key, value in pairs:
            if key in keys:
                duplicates.append(key)
            keys.append(key)
        return dict(pairs), duplicates
    
    try:
        data, duplicates = json.loads(content, object_pairs_hook=detect_duplicates)
        if duplicates:
            print(f'{file_path}: Duplicate keys found: {duplicates}')
        else:
            print(f'{file_path}: ✅ No duplicate keys found')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{file_path}: Error - {e}')

            keys = []
            duplicates = []
            for key, value in pairs:
                if key in keys:
                    duplicates.append(key)
                keys.append(key)
            return dict(pairs), duplicates

            keys = []
            duplicates = []

                if key in keys:
                    duplicates.append(key)
                keys.append(key)
            return dict(pairs), duplicates
        
        data, duplicates = json.loads(content, object_pairs_hook=detect_duplicates)

            print(f'{file_path}: ❌ Duplicate keys: {duplicates}')

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, updateDoc, writeBatch, collection, addDoc, serverTimestamp } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport Card, { CardHeader, CardBody, CardTitle } from '../ui/Card';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport { Checkbox } from '../ui/Checkbox';\nimport Modal from '../ui/Modal';\nimport Select from '../ui/Select';\nimport { Textarea } from '../ui/Textarea';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  Calendar, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Clock, \n  Star,\n  Send,\n  AlertTriangle\n} from 'lucide-react';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\n\ninterface BulkApplicationManagerProps {\n  applications: JobApplication[];\n  onApplicationsUpdated: () =\u003e void;\n}",

        "contents": "const BulkApplicationManager: React.FC\u003cBulkApplicationManagerProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const executeBulkMessage = async (batch: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!bulkMessage.trim()) {\n      throw new Error('Message is required');\n    }\n\n    for (const applicationId of selectedApplications) {\n      const application = applications.find(app =\u003e app.id === applicationId);\n      if (!application) continue;\n\n      // Add message to the application's messages subcollection\n      const messageRef = collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'messages');\n      await addDoc(messageRef, {\n        senderId: job?.postedById,\n        senderName: (job as any)?.companyName || 'Job Poster',\n        message: bulkMessage,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        type: 'system'\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeBulkInterview = async (batch: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!interviewData.date || !interviewData.time) {\n      throw new Error('Interview date and time are required');\n    }\n\n    for (const applicationId of selectedApplications) {\n      const applicationRef = doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId);\n      \n      // Update application status to interviewed\n      batch.update(applicationRef, {\n        status: 'interviewed',\n        lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),\n        interviewScheduled: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n\n      // Add interview details\n      const interviewRef = collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'interviews');\n      await addDoc(interviewRef, {\n        date: interviewData.date,\n        time: interviewData.time,\n        duration: interviewData.duration,\n        type: interviewData.type,\n        notes: interviewData.notes,\n        scheduledBy: job?.postedById,\n        scheduledAt: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n    }\n  };",

        "contents": "const ApplicationMessaging: React.FC\u003cApplicationMessagingProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const subscribeToMessages = () =\u003e {\n    const messagesQuery = query(\n      collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'messages'),\n      orderBy('timestamp', 'asc'),\n      limit(100)\n    );\n    \n    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(messagesQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const messagesData = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n        id: doc.id,\n        ...doc.data()\n      })) as Message[];\n      setMessages(messagesData);\n    });\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  };\n\n  const sendMessage = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!newMessage.trim() || !application || !currentUser) return;\n\n    // Defensive: ensure applicationId is a string and matches parent\n    if (!applicationId || typeof applicationId !== 'string') {\n      toast.error('Invalid application ID');\n      console.error('Invalid applicationId:', applicationId);\n      return;\n    }\n    if (!currentUser.uid) {\n      toast.error('User not authenticated');\n      console.error('No currentUser.uid');\n      return;\n    }\n    // Check parent document existence\n    try {\n      const parentDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (!parentDoc.exists()) {\n        toast.error('Application does not exist.         "originalContents": "\n\n    try {\n      console.log('Attempting to send message:', messageData);\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'messages'), messageData);\n      // Create notification for the recipient\n      const jobPostingRef = doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId);\n      const jobPostingSnap = await getDoc(jobPostingRef);\n      const jobPosting = jobPostingSnap.data();\n      // Determine recipient: if sender is applicant, recipient is job poster; else recipient is applicant\n      const recipientId = currentUser.uid === application.applicantId ? jobPosting?.postedById : application.applicantId;\n      if (recipientId) {\n        await addDoc(collection(db, 'users', recipientId, 'notifications'), {\n          type: 'application_message',\n          message: &#96;New message from ${currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email} regarding job application&#96;,\n          timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n          read: false,\n          userId: recipientId,\n          relatedId: applicationId,\n          applicationId: applicationId,\n          senderId: currentUser.uid,\n          extra: {\n            applicationId: applicationId,\n            senderName: currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email\n          }\n        });\n      }\n      setNewMessage('');\n      toast.success('Message sent successfully!');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending message:', error, '\\nMessage data:', messageData, '\\napplicationId:', applicationId, '\\ncurrentUser:', currentUser);\n      toast.error('Failed to send message. Please try again.');\n    } finally {\n      setIsSendingMessage(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleString();\n  };\n\n  const isCurrentUser = (senderId: string) =\u003e {\n    return senderId === currentUser?.uid;\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst ApplicationStatusTracker: React.FC\u003cApplicationStatusTrackerProps\u003e = ({ applicationId }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { applicationId: urlApplicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null); // Changed to any for now as JobPosting type is removed\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [showMessaging, setShowMessaging] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as any); // Changed to any for now\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\n\nconst ApplicationSuccessPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { applicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId!));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as JobPosting);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n          {/* Additional Notes */}\n          \u003cdiv className=\"mb-8\"\u003e\n            \u003clabel className=\"block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\"\u003e\n              {t('applyJob.additionalNotes')}\n            \u003c/label\u003e\n            \u003ctextarea\n              value={formData.notes}\n              onChange={(e) =\u003e handleInputChange('notes', e.target.value)}\n              placeholder={t('applyJob.additionalNotesPlaceholder')}\n              className=\"w-full h-24 p-4 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg focus:border-gray-400 focus:outline-none resize-none font-light\"\n            /\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n\n          {/* Submit Button */}\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between pt-6 border-t border-gray-100\"\u003e\n            \u003cbutton\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() =\u003e navigate(-1)}\n              className=\"px-6 py-3 text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 font-light transition-colors\"\n            \u003e\n              {t('common.cancel')}\n            \u003c/button\u003e\n            \n            \u003cbutton\n              type=\"submit\"\n              disabled={isSubmitting}\n              className=\"px-8 py-3 bg-gray-900 text-white font-light rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed\"\n            \u003e\n              {isSubmitting ? (\n                \u003cspan className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"\u003e\n                  \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-4 w-4 border-b-2 border-white\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n                  {t('applyJob.submitting')}\n                \u003c/span\u003e\n              ) : (\n                t('applyJob.submitApplication')\n              )}\n            \u003c/button\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/form\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};",

        "contents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\n\nconst ApplicationSuccessPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { applicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId!));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as JobPosting);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "const JobDetailPage: React.FC =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const incrementJobViews = async () =\u003e {\n    // Completely disable view tracking to eliminate Firebase connection errors\n    // This functionality is not critical for the user experience\n    return;\n  };\n\n  // Check if user has already saved this job\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    // Reset saved state when user or job changes\n    setIsSaved(false);\n    \n    if (auth.currentUser \u0026\u0026 jobId) {\n      const savedJobRef = doc(db, 'savedJobs', &#96;${auth.currentUser.uid}_${jobId}&#96;);\n      \n      // Use a more robust approach to check saved status\n      const checkSavedStatus = async () =\u003e {\n        try {\n          console.log('🔍 Checking saved status for user:', auth.currentUser?.uid, 'job:', jobId);\n          console.log('📄 Document path:', savedJobRef.path);\n          \n          const docSnap = await getDoc(savedJobRef);\n          const exists = docSnap.exists();\n          console.log('✅ Saved job exists:', exists);\n          setIsSaved(exists);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.error('❌ Error checking saved status:', error);\n          console.error('🔍 Error code:', error.code);\n          console.error('🔍 Error message:', error.message);\n          \n          // Don't show error to user, just assume not saved\n          setIsSaved(false);\n          \n          // Handle specific permission errors gracefully\n          if (error.code === 'permission-denied') {\n            console.log('⚠️ Permission denied for saved job check - this is expected for new users');\n          }\n        }\n      };\n      \n      checkSavedStatus();\n    }\n  }, [auth.currentUser, jobId]);",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport class FileUploadService {\n  private static readonly MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB\n  private static readonly ALLOWED_TYPES = {\n    resume: ['.pdf', '.doc', '.docx'],\n    attachments: ['.pdf', '.doc', '.docx', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.gif']\n  };\n\n  static validateFile(file: File, type: 'resume' | 'attachments'): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } {\n    // Check file size\n    if (file.size \u003e this.MAX_FILE_SIZE) {\n      return {\n        isValid: false,\n        error: &#96;File size must be less than ${this.MAX_FILE_SIZE / (1024 * 1024)}MB&#96;\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Check file type\n    const allowedExtensions = this.ALLOWED_TYPES[type];\n    const fileExtension = '.' + file.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();\n    \n    if (!allowedExtensions.includes(fileExtension)) {\n      return {\n        isValid: false,\n        error: &#96;File type not allowed. Allowed types: ${allowedExtensions.join(', ')}&#96;\n      };\n    }\n\n    return { isValid: true };\n  }",

        "contents": "export class MessagingService {\n  ...\n  static async uploadFileToStorage(file: File, pathPrefix: string = 'chat-uploads'): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n\n      \n      ...\n\n      \n      // For other errors (network, permissions, etc.), try data URL fallback for small files\n      const maxDataUrlSize = 200 * 1024; // 200KB - increased for better fallback\n      if (file.size \u003c= maxDataUrlSize) {\n        console.log('[MessagingService] Upload failed, trying data URL fallback for small file');\n        return new Promise((resolve) =\u003e {\n          const reader = new FileReader();\n          reader.onload = () =\u003e {\n            const dataUrl = reader.result as string;\n            // Check if data URL is too long for Firestore (limit to 500KB to be safe)\n            if (dataUrl.length \u003e 500 * 1024) {\n              console.warn('[MessagingService] Data URL too long, using placeholder');\n              resolve(&#96;FILE_TOO_LARGE:${file.name}&#96;);\n            } else {\n              console.log('[MessagingService] Using data URL fallback successfully');\n              resolve(dataUrl);\n            }\n          };\n          reader.readAsDataURL(file);\n        });\n      } else {\n        // For larger files that fail to upload due to non-size issues, return a placeholder\n        console.warn('[MessagingService] Upload failed for large file, using placeholder');\n        return &#96;UPLOAD_FAILED:${file.name}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "export class MessagingService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // ===== DIRECT MESSAGE OPERATIONS =====\n  \n  static async sendDirectMessage(\n    senderId: string, \n    receiverId: string, \n    content: string, \n    messageType: 'text' | 'image' | 'file' | 'voice' | 'project_invite' = 'text', \n    relatedProjectId?: string,\n    fileUrl?: string\n  ): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[MessagingService] Sending direct message from', senderId, 'to', receiverId);\n      \n      // Check permissions\n      const canMessage = await this.canSendMessage(senderId, receiverId);\n      if (!canMessage) {\n        throw new Error('Cannot send message to this user. They may not allow messages from non-followers.');\n      }\n\n      // Get or create conversation\n      const conversationId = await this.getConversationId(senderId, receiverId);\n\n      // Create message data, filtering out undefined values\n      const messageData: any = {\n        senderId,\n        content,\n        messageType,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        isRead: false,\n        reactions: [],\n        status: 'sent'\n      };\n\n      // Only add relatedProjectId if it's defined\n      if (relatedProjectId) {\n        messageData.relatedProjectId = relatedProjectId;\n      }\n      // Only add fileUrl if it's defined and not too long\n      if (fileUrl) {\n        // Check if fileUrl is too long for Firestore (limit to 500KB to be safe)\n        if (fileUrl.length \u003e 500 * 1024) {\n          console.warn('[MessagingService] File URL too long, truncating:', fileUrl.length, 'bytes');\n          messageData.fileUrl = &#96;FILE_TOO_LARGE:${fileUrl.split('/').pop() || 'file'}&#96;;\n        } else {\n          messageData.fileUrl = fileUrl;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Add message to conversation\n      const messagesRef = collection(db, 'conversations', conversationId, 'messages');\n      const docRef = await addDoc(messagesRef, messageData);\n      \n      // Update conversation metadata\n      const conversationRef = doc(db, 'conversations', conversationId);",

They may not allow messages from non-followers.');\n      }\n\n      // Get or create conversation\n      const conversationId = await this.getConversationId(senderId, receiverId);\n\n      // Create message data, filtering out undefined values\n      const messageData: any = {\n        senderId,\n        content,\n        messageType,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        isRead: false,\n        reactions: [],\n        status: 'sent'\n      };\n\n      // Only add relatedProjectId if it's defined\n      if (relatedProjectId) {\n        messageData.relatedProjectId = relatedProjectId;\n      }\n      // Only add fileUrl if it's defined and not too long\n      if (fileUrl) {\n        // Check if fileUrl is too long for Firestore (limit to 500KB to be safe)\n        if (fileUrl.length \u003e 500 * 1024) {\n          console.warn('[MessagingService] File URL too long, truncating:', fileUrl.length, 'bytes');\n          messageData.fileUrl = &#96;FILE_TOO_LARGE:${fileUrl.split('/').pop() || 'file'}&#96;;\n        } else {\n          messageData.fileUrl = fileUrl;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Add message to conversation\n      const messagesRef = collection(db, 'conversations', conversationId, 'messages');\n      const docRef = await addDoc(messagesRef, messageData);\n      \n      // Update conversation metadata\n      const conversationRef = doc(db, 'conversations', conversationId);",

        "originalContents": "import { \n  collection, \n  query, \n  where, \n  orderBy, \n  getDocs, \n  addDoc, \n  updateDoc, \n  doc, \n  onSnapshot, \n  serverTimestamp,\n  writeBatch,\n  getDoc,\n  deleteDoc,\n  limit,\n  Timestamp,\n  DocumentData,\n  QueryDocumentSnapshot,\n  setDoc,\n  increment,\n  arrayUnion,\n  arrayRemove\n} from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../firebase';\nimport { DirectMessage, ChatRoom, ChatSettings, MessageReaction, ChatPresence } from '../types/Chat';\nimport { SocialService } from './socialService';\nimport { storage } from '../firebase';\nimport { ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL, ref as storageRef, deleteObject } from 'firebase/storage';\n\nexport interface ConversationSummary {\n  userId: string;\n  userName: string;\n  userAvatar?: string;\n  userRole?: string;\n  userCompany?: string;\n  userLocation?: string;\n  lastMessage?: string;\n  lastMessageTime?: Date;\n  unreadCount: number;\n  isOnline?: boolean;\n  lastSeen?: Date;\n  conversationId?: string;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class MessagingService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  static async getDirectMessages(userId1: string, userId2: string, limitCount: number = 50): Promise\u003cDirectMessage[]\u003e {\n    try {\n      const conversationId = await this.getConversationId(userId1, userId2);\n      const messagesRef = collection(db, 'conversations', conversationId, 'messages');\n      const q = query(\n        messagesRef,\n        orderBy('timestamp', 'desc'),\n        limit(limitCount)\n      );\n      \n      const snapshot = await getDocs(q);\n      const messages: DirectMessage[] = [];\n      \n      snapshot.forEach((doc) =\u003e {\n        const data = doc.data();\n        messages.push({\n          id: doc.id,\n          senderId: data.senderId,\n          receiverId: data.senderId === userId1 ? userId2 : userId1, // Determine receiver based on sender\n          content: data.content,\n          timestamp: data.timestamp?.toDate() || new Date(),\n          isRead: data.isRead || false,\n          messageType: data.messageType || 'text',\n          status: data.status || 'sent',\n          fileUrl: data.fileUrl,\n          fileName: data.fileName,\n          fileSize: data.fileSize,\n          fileType: data.fileType,\n          reactions: data.reactions || []\n        });\n      });\n      \n      // Sort by timestamp ascending for display\n      return messages.reverse();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[MessagingService] Error getting messages:', error);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class MessagingService {\n  ...\n  static async deleteMessage(messageId: string, fileUrl?: string, messageType?: string, deletedByUserId?: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n\n\n      ...\n\n\n      if (isSenderDeletion) {\n        // Sender deletion: Update message to show as deleted\n        let placeholder = '[Attachment deleted]';\n        let deletedType = 'deleted_file';\n        \n        if (messageType === 'image') {\n          placeholder = '[Image deleted]';\n          deletedType = 'deleted_image';\n        } else if (messageType === 'voice') {\n          placeholder = '[Audio deleted]';\n          deletedType = 'deleted_audio';\n        } else if (messageType === 'text') {\n          placeholder = '[Message deleted]';\n          deletedType = 'deleted_text';\n        }\n\n        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'conversations', conversationId, 'messages', messageId), {\n          content: placeholder,\n          fileUrl: null,\n          messageType: deletedType,\n          deletedAt: serverTimestamp()\n        });\n\n        // If there's a file URL and it's not a placeholder, delete from Firebase Storage\n        if (fileUrl \u0026\u0026 \n            !fileUrl.startsWith('data:') \u0026\u0026 \n            !fileUrl.startsWith('FILE_TOO_LARGE:') \u0026\u0026\n            !fileUrl.startsWith('UPLOAD_FAILED:') \u0026\u0026\n            fileUrl.includes('firebase')) {\n          try {\n            const fileRef = ref(storage, fileUrl);\n            await deleteObject(fileRef);\n            console.log('[MessagingService] File deleted from Firebase Storage');\n          } catch (storageError) {\n            console.warn('[MessagingService] Could not delete file from storage:', storageError);\n            // Don't throw error if file deletion fails, message deletion is more important\n          }\n        }\n\n        console.log('[MessagingService] Message marked as deleted for everyone');\n      }",

        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Get a user's profile by ID\n   */\n  static async getProfile(userId: string): Promise\u003cProfile | null\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check cache first\n      const cached = this.profileCache.get(userId);\n      if (cached \u0026\u0026 Date.now() - cached.cachedAt \u003c this.CACHE_TTL) {\n        return cached.profile;\n      }\n\n      // Try to get crew profile first\n      const crewDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'crewProfiles', userId));\n      if (crewDoc.exists()) {\n        const data = crewDoc.data();\n        const profile: Profile = {\n          id: crewDoc.id,\n          uid: data.uid || crewDoc.id,\n          name: data.name || '',\n          username: data.username || '',\n          bio: data.bio,\n          profileImageUrl: data.profileImageUrl,\n          jobTitles: data.jobTitles || [],\n          residences: data.residences || [],\n          projects: data.projects || [],\n          education: data.education || [],\n          contactInfo: data.contactInfo,\n          otherInfo: data.otherInfo,\n          isPublished: Boolean(data.isPublished),\n          availability: data.availability,\n          languages: data.languages || []\n        };\n        \n        // Cache the result with timestamp\n        this.profileCache.set(userId, {\n          profile,\n          cachedAt: Date.now(),\n        });\n        \n        return profile;\n      }\n\n      // If not a crew profile, try to get a regular user profile\n      const userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', userId));\n      if (userDoc.exists()) {\n        const data = userDoc.data() || {};\n        const profile: Profile = {\n          id: userDoc.id,\n          displayName: data.displayName || data.email?.split('@')[0] || 'User',\n          email: data.email,\n          photoURL: data.photoURL,\n        };\n        \n        // Cache the result with timestamp\n        this.profileCache.set(userId, {\n          profile,\n          cachedAt: Date.now(),\n        });\n        \n        return profile;\n      }\n\n      return null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error getting profile:', error);\n      return null;\n    }",

        "contents": "export class MessagingService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  static subscribeToConversation(\n    userId1: string, \n    userId2: string, \n    callback: (messages: DirectMessage[]) =\u003e void\n  ): () =\u003e void {\n    const cacheKey = &#96;${userId1}-${userId2}&#96;;\n    \n    // Clean up existing listener\n    if (this.listeners.has(cacheKey)) {\n      this.listeners.get(cacheKey)?.();\n    }\n\n    // Set up the listener immediately\n    const setupListener = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const conversationId = await this.getConversationId(userId1, userId2);\n        const messagesRef = collection(db, 'conversations', conversationId, 'messages');\n        const q = query(\n          messagesRef,\n          orderBy('timestamp', 'asc')\n        );\n        \n        return onSnapshot(q, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n          const messages: DirectMessage[] = [];\n          \n          snapshot.forEach((doc) =\u003e {\n            const data = doc.data();\n            messages.push({\n              id: doc.id,\n              senderId: data.senderId,\n              receiverId: data.senderId === userId1 ? userId2 : userId1,\n              content: data.content,\n              timestamp: data.timestamp?.toDate() || new Date(),\n              isRead: data.isRead || false,\n              messageType: data.messageType || 'text',\n              status: data.status || 'sent',\n              fileUrl: data.fileUrl,\n              fileName: data.fileName,\n              fileSize: data.fileSize,\n              fileType: data.fileType,\n              reactions: data.reactions || []\n            });\n          });\n          \n          this.messageCache.set(cacheKey, messages);\n          callback(messages);\n        });\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('[MessagingService] Error setting up conversation listener:', error);\n        return () =\u003e {};\n      }\n    };\n\n    // Set up the listener and store the cleanup function\n    setupListener().then(cleanup =\u003e {\n      this.listeners.set(cacheKey, cleanup);\n    });",

        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Get a user's profile by ID\n   */\n  static async getProfile(userId: string): Promise\u003cSocialUser | null\u003e {\n    // Check cache first\n    const cached = profileCache.get(userId);\n    if (cached \u0026\u0026 Date.now() - Excellent! The build completed successfully with no errors. Now let me create a summary of what I've implemented to fix the issue:

## ✅ Issue Fixed: Job Posters Can Now View Uploaded Documents by Job Applicants

### **Problem**
Job posters couldn't view the uploaded documents (resume and attachments) that applicants submitted when they completed the job application form. The application detail view was missing a section to display these documents.

### **Solution Implemented**

#### 1. **Fixed Job Application Form** (`JobApplicationForm.tsx`)
- **Before**: Resume was stored as just an `resumeId` (string), making it impossible to retrieve the actual file
- **After**: Resume is now properly stored as an attachment with type `'resume'` in the `attachments` array, including:
  - File URL for download/viewing
  - File name
  - File size
  - Upload timestamp
  - Proper file type classification

#### 2. **Enhanced Application Status Tracker** (`ApplicationStatusTracker.tsx`)
- Added a new **"Uploaded Documents"** section in the sidebar
- **Resume Display**: Shows resume with special blue styling and dedicated view/download buttons
- **Additional Documents**: Lists all other uploaded attachments with file icons, names, and sizes
- **File Actions**: View and download buttons for each document
- **Empty State**: Shows appropriate message when no documents are uploaded

#### 3. **Enhanced Job Applicants Page** (`JobApplicantsPage.tsx`)
- Added the same **"Uploaded Documents"** section to the applicant modal
- Job posters can now view documents directly from the applicants list without navigating to individual application pages
- Consistent UI with the Application Status Tracker

#### 4. **File Handling Features**
- **View Files**: Opens documents in new browser tab for preview
- **Download Files**: Downloads files with original filenames
- **File Icons**: Shows appropriate icons based on file type (PDF, DOC, images, etc.)
- **File Size Display**: Shows human-readable file sizes
- **Type Classification**: Distinguishes between resume and other attachments

### **Key Features Added**

1. **Resume Display**: 
   - Special blue styling to highlight the resume
   - Clear labeling as "Resume - Submitted with application"
   - Dedicated view and download buttons

2. **Additional Documents**:
   - Lists all other uploaded files (portfolio, references, etc.)
   - Shows file count in section header
   - Individual file cards with icons and metadata

3. **File Actions**:
   - **View**: Opens file in new tab for preview
   - **Download**: Downloads file with original filename
   - Hover effects and tooltips for better UX

4. **Responsive Design**:
   - Works on both desktop and mobile
   - Consistent styling with the rest of the application
   - Proper spacing and typography

### **Technical Implementation**

- **File Storage**: Uses existing Firebase Storage infrastructure
- **Type Safety**: Proper TypeScript interfaces for file attachments
- **Error Handling**: Graceful handling of missing files or network issues
- **Performance**: Efficient file loading and display
- **Accessibility**: Proper ARIA labels and keyboard navigation

### **User Experience**

**For Job Posters:**
- Can now easily view and download applicant resumes and portfolios
- No need to contact applicants to request documents
- Better evaluation of candidates with access to their materials
- Streamlined hiring process

**For Applicants:**
- Their uploaded documents are now properly displayed to potential employers
- Better chance of being considered with visible portfolio and resume
- Professional presentation of their materials

The implementation ensures that job posters have full access to all documents submitted by applicants, making the hiring process more efficient and transparent.

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  \n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState\u003cJobApplicationFormData\u003e({\n    coverLetter: '',\n    expectedSalary: undefined,\n    availabilityDate: '',\n    notes: '',\n    resumeFile: null,\n    resumeUploaded: null,\n    attachments: [],\n    attachmentsUploaded: []\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId!));\n      \n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        setJob({\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting);\n      } else {\n        setError('Job not found');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      setError('Failed to load job details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof JobApplicationFormData, value: any) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      [field]: value\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (files: File[]) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      attachments: [...prev.attachments, ...files]\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =\u003e {\n    // All fields are now optional -         "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  \n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState\u003cJobApplicationFormData\u003e({\n    coverLetter: '',\n    expectedSalary: undefined,\n    availabilityDate: '',\n    notes: '',\n    resumeFile: null,\n    resumeUploaded: null,\n    attachments: [],\n    attachmentsUploaded: []\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId!));\n      \n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        setJob({\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting);\n      } else {\n        setError('Job not found');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      setError('Failed to load job details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof JobApplicationFormData, value: any) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      [field]: value\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (files: File[]) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      attachments: [...prev.attachments, ...files]\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =\u003e {\n    // All fields are now optional - just check if user is authenticated\n    if (!currentUser) {\n      setError('You must be logged in to apply');\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  };",

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "contents": "const BulkApplicationManager: React.FC\u003cBulkApplicationManagerProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const executeBulkMessage = async (batch: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!bulkMessage.trim()) {\n      throw new Error('Message is required');\n    }\n\n    for (const applicationId of selectedApplications) {\n      const application = applications.find(app =\u003e app.id === applicationId);\n      if (!application) continue;\n\n      // Add message to the application's messages subcollection\n      const messageRef = collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'messages');\n      await addDoc(messageRef, {\n        senderId: job?.postedById,\n        senderName: (job as any)?.companyName || 'Job Poster',\n        message: bulkMessage,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        type: 'system'\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeBulkInterview = async (batch: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!interviewData.date || !interviewData.time) {\n      throw new Error('Interview date and time are required');\n    }\n\n    for (const applicationId of selectedApplications) {\n      const applicationRef = doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId);\n      \n      // Update application status to interviewed\n      batch.update(applicationRef, {\n        status: 'interviewed',\n        lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),\n        interviewScheduled: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n\n      // Add interview details\n      const interviewRef = collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'interviews');\n      await addDoc(interviewRef, {\n        date: interviewData.date,\n        time: interviewData.time,\n        duration: interviewData.duration,\n        type: interviewData.type,\n        notes: interviewData.notes,\n        scheduledBy: job?.postedById,\n        scheduledAt: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, updateDoc, writeBatch, collection, addDoc, serverTimestamp } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport Card, { CardHeader, CardBody, CardTitle } from '../ui/Card';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport { Checkbox } from '../ui/Checkbox';\nimport Modal from '../ui/Modal';\nimport Select from '../ui/Select';\nimport { Textarea } from '../ui/Textarea';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  Calendar, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Clock, \n  Star,\n  Send,\n  AlertTriangle\n} from 'lucide-react';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\n\ninterface BulkApplicationManagerProps {\n  applications: JobApplication[];\n  onApplicationsUpdated: () =\u003e void;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "const BulkApplicationManager: React.FC\u003cBulkApplicationManagerProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const executeBulkMessage = async (batch: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!bulkMessage.trim()) {\n      throw new Error('Message is required');\n    }\n\n    for (const applicationId of selectedApplications) {\n      const application = applications.find(app =\u003e app.id === applicationId);\n      if (!application) continue;\n\n      // Add message to the application's messages subcollection\n      const messageRef = collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'messages');\n      await addDoc(messageRef, {\n        senderId: job?.postedById,\n        senderName: (job as any)?.companyName || 'Job Poster',\n        message: bulkMessage,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        type: 'system'\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeBulkInterview = async (batch: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!interviewData.date || !interviewData.time) {\n      throw new Error('Interview date and time are required');\n    }\n\n    for (const applicationId of selectedApplications) {\n      const applicationRef = doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId);\n      \n      // Update application status to interviewed\n      batch.update(applicationRef, {\n        status: 'interviewed',\n        lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),\n        interviewScheduled: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n\n      // Add interview details\n      const interviewRef = collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'interviews');\n      await addDoc(interviewRef, {\n        date: interviewData.date,\n        time: interviewData.time,\n        duration: interviewData.duration,\n        type: interviewData.type,\n        notes: interviewData.notes,\n        scheduledBy: job?.postedById,\n        scheduledAt: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const executeBulkMessage = async (batch: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!bulkMessage.trim()) {\n      throw new Error('Message is required');\n    }\n\n    for (const applicationId of selectedApplications) {\n      const application = applications.find(app =\u003e app.id === applicationId);\n      if (!application) continue;\n\n      // Add message to the application's messages subcollection\n      const messageRef = collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'messages');\n      await addDoc(messageRef, {\n        senderId: job?.postedById,\n        senderName: (job as any)?.companyName || 'Job Poster',\n        message: bulkMessage,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        type: 'system'\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const executeBulkInterview = async (batch: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!interviewData.date || !interviewData.time) {\n      throw new Error('Interview date and time are required');\n    }\n\n    for (const applicationId of selectedApplications) {\n      const applicationRef = doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId);\n      \n      // Update application status to interviewed\n      batch.update(applicationRef, {\n        status: 'interviewed',\n        lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),\n        interviewScheduled: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n\n      // Add interview details\n      const interviewRef = collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'interviews');\n      await addDoc(interviewRef, {\n        date: interviewData.date,\n        time: interviewData.time,\n        duration: interviewData.duration,\n        type: interviewData.type,\n        notes: interviewData.notes,\n        scheduledBy: job?.postedById,\n        scheduledAt: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n    }\n  };",

if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDocs(query(\n            collection(db, 'jobPostings'),\n            where('__name__', '==', app.jobId)\n id: jobDoc.docs[0].id,\n                title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n                companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n                department:   };\n        setStats(newStats);",

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  \n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState\u003cJobApplicationFormData\u003e({\n    coverLetter: '',\n    expectedSalary: undefined,\n    availabilityDate: '',\n    notes: '',\n    resumeFile: null,\n    resumeUploaded: null,\n    attachments: [],\n    attachmentsUploaded: []\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId!));\n      \n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        setJob({\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting);\n      } else {\n        setError('Job not found');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      setError('Failed to load job details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof JobApplicationFormData, value: any) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      [field]: value\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (files: File[]) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      attachments: [...prev.attachments, ...files]\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =\u003e {\n    // All fields are now optional - just check if user is authenticated\n    if (!currentUser) {\n      setError('You must be logged in to apply');\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  \n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState\u003cJobApplicationFormData\u003e({\n    coverLetter: '',\n    expectedSalary: undefined,\n    availabilityDate: '',\n    notes: '',\n    resumeFile: null,\n    resumeUploaded: null,\n    attachments: [],\n    attachmentsUploaded: []\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId!));\n      \n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        setJob({\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting);\n      } else {\n        setError('Job not found');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      setError('Failed to load job details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof JobApplicationFormData, value: any) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      [field]: value\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (files: File[]) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      attachments: [...prev.attachments, ...files]\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =\u003e {\n    // All fields are now optional - just check if user is authenticated\n    if (!currentUser) {\n      setError('You must be logged in to apply');\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  };",

        "contents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\n\nconst ApplicationSuccessPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { applicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId!));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as JobPosting);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, collection, query, where, getDocs, updateDoc, addDoc, serverTimestamp, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { FileUploadService } from '../../utilities/fileUploadService';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport Card from '../ui/Card';\nimport ApplicationMessaging from './ApplicationMessaging';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Star, \n  Heart, \n  Eye, \n  Calendar,\n  MapPin,\n  DollarSign,\n  Briefcase,\n  Clock,\n  Phone,\n  Mail,\n  ExternalLink,\n  Filter,\n  Search,\n  MoreHorizontal,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Award,\n  TrendingUp,\n  Download,\n  FileText,\n  Paperclip\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface ApplicantProfile {\n  uid: string;\n  name: string;\n  username: string;\n  bio: string;\n  jobTitles: string[];\n  experience: string;\n  location: string;\n  skills: string[];\n  availability: string;\n  expectedSalary?: number;\n  portfolio?: string;\n  phone?: string;\n  email?: string;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  \n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState\u003cJobApplicationFormData\u003e({\n    coverLetter: '',\n    expectedSalary: undefined,\n    availabilityDate: '',\n    notes: '',\n    resumeFile: null,\n    resumeUploaded: null,\n    attachments: [],\n    attachmentsUploaded: []\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId!));\n      \n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        setJob({\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting);\n      } else {\n        setError('Job not found');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      setError('Failed to load job details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof JobApplicationFormData, value: any) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      [field]: value\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (files: File[]) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      attachments: [...prev.attachments, ...files]\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =\u003e {\n    // All fields are now optional - just check if user is authenticated\n    if (!currentUser) {\n      setError('You must be logged in to apply');\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  };",
