      "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { collection, query, where, orderBy, getDocs, limit, getDoc, doc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { JobApplicationService } from '../../utilities/jobApplicationService';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\n\ninterface ApplicationStats {\n  total: number;\n  pending: number;\n  accepted: number;\n  rejected: number;\n  interviewScheduled: number;\n  responseRate: number;\n  avgResponseTime: number;\n}\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteApplication = async (applicationId: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!window.confirm('Are you sure you want to withdraw this application? This action cannot be undone.')) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      await JobApplicationService.deleteApplication(applicationId);\n      toast.success('Application withdrawn successfully');\n      // Reload applications to update the list\n      loadApplications();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error deleting application:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to withdraw application');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const calculateStats = () =\u003e {\n    const total = applications.length;\n    const pending = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'pending').length;\n    const reviewed = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'reviewed').length;\n    const shortlisted = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'shortlisted').length;\n    const interviewed = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'interviewed').length;\n    const hired = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'hired').length;\n    const rejected = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'rejected').length;\n    \n    const responseRate = total \u003e 0 ? ((reviewed + shortlisted + interviewed + hired + rejected) / total) * 100 : 0;\n    \n    // Calculate average response time using reviewedAt\n    const respondedApps = applications.filter(app =\u003e \n      app.status !== 'pending' \u0026\u0026 app.reviewedAt \u0026\u0026 app.appliedAt\n    );\n    \n    let avgResponseTime = 0;\n    if (respondedApps.length \u003e 0) {\n      const totalDays = respondedApps.reduce((sum, app) =\u003e {\n        const appliedDate = app.appliedAt?.toDate ? app.appliedAt.toDate() : new Date(app.appliedAt);\n        const reviewedDate = app.reviewedAt?.toDate ? name: 'Unknown',\n              username: 'unknown',\n              bio: '',\n              jobTitles: [],\n            };\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('Error case 'pending': return '⏳';\n      case 'reviewed': return '👁️';\n      case 'shortlisted': return '⭐';\n      case 'interviewed': return '📅';\n      case 'hired': return '✅';\n      case 'rejected':       "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplicationService } from pending: 0,\n    reviewed: 0,\n    shortlisted: 0,\n    interviewed: 0,\n    hired: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    withdrawn: 0\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n                postedById: jobDoc.docs[0].id, // Assuming jobId is the document ID\n              } as JobPostingSummary\n            };\n          }\n j.application.status === 'withdrawn').length\n        };\n        setStats(newStats);\n        \n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applications:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applications');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);\n\n  // Filter and sort applications\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    let filtered = applications;\n\n    // Status filter\n    if (statusFilter !== 'all') {\n      filtered = filtered.filter(app =\u003e app.application.status === statusFilter);\n    }\n\n    // Search filter\n    if (searchTerm) {\n      filtered = filtered.filter(app =\u003e \n        app.job?.title?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||\n        app.job?.companyName?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||\n filtered.sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n      let aValue: any, bValue: any;\n      \n      switch (sortBy) {\n        case 'appliedAt':\n          aValue = a.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n          bValue = b.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n          break;\n        case 'company':\n          aValue = a.job?.companyName || '';\n          bValue = b.job?.companyName || '';\n          break;\n        case 'title':\n          aValue = a.job?.title || '';\n          bValue = b.job?.title || '';\n          break;\n        case 'status':\n          aValue = a.application.status;\n          bValue = b.application.status;\n          break;\n        default:\n          aValue = a.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n          bValue = b.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n      }\n\n      if (sortOrder === 'asc') {\n        return aValue \u003e bValue ? 1 : -1;\n      } else {\n        return aValue \u003c bValue ? 1 : -1;\n      }\n    });\n\n    setFilteredApplications(filtered);\n  }, [applications, statusFilter, searchTerm, sortBy, sortOrder]);\n\n  const getStatusColor = (status: string) =\u003e {\n    const \u003c/Card\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\" className=\"text-center p-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-2xl font-bold \u003c/Card\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\" className=\"text-center p-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-6\"\u003e{t('jobDashboard.jobPerformance')}\u003c/h3\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"space-y-4\"\u003e\n          {postedJobs.slice(0, 5).map((job) =\u003e (\n            \u003cdiv key={job.id} className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"flex-1\"\u003e\n                \u003cp className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 truncate\"\u003e{job.title}\u003c/p\u003e\n                \u003cp className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\"\u003e{job.department}\u003c/p\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003cdiv      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n\n      \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6\"\u003e\n        \u003ch3 className=\"text-xl font-light          return (\n              \u003cdiv key={job.id} className=\"border-b border-gray-100 pb-4 last:border-b-0\"\u003e\n                \u003cp className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003e{job.title}\u003c/p\u003e\n                \u003cdiv className=\"flex gap-4 text-xs\"\u003e\n                  \u003cspan className=\"text-yellow-600\"\u003e⏳ {pending} {t('jobDashboard.pending')}\u003c/span\u003e\n                  \u003cspan className=\"text-blue-600\"\u003e👁️ {reviewed} {t('jobDashboard.reviewed')}\u003c/span\u003e\n                  \u003cspan {t('jobDashboard.hired')}\u003c/span\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            );\n          })}\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-8 py-16\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv         \u003cp className=\"text-xl font-light text-gray-600 max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed\"\u003e\n            {t('jobDashboard.subtitle')}\n          \u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n {[\n              { id: 'overview', label: t('jobDashboard.overview'), icon: '📊' },\n              { id: 'jobs', label: t('jobDashboard.postedJobs'), icon: '💼' },\n              { id: 'applications',              key={tab.id}\n                onClick={() =\u003e setActiveTab(tab.id as any)}\n                className={&#96;flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-lg font-light transition-all duration-300 ${\n                  activeTab === tab.id\n                    ? (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-12\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003e{t('jobDashboard.loading')}\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        ) : (\n          \u003c\u003e\n            {activeTab === 'overview' \u0026\u0026 renderOverview()}\n            {activeTab === 'jobs' \u0026\u0026 renderPostedJobs()}\n            {activeTab === 'applications' \u0026\u0026 renderApplications()}\n            {activeTab === 'analytics' \u0026\u0026 renderAnalytics()}\n          \u003c/\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};\n\nexport default JobPosterDashboard; ",

      "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { \n  doc, \n  getDoc, \n  collection, \n  addDoc, \n  serverTimestamp, \n  onSnapshot, \n  query, \n  orderBy, \n  limit,\n  getDocs,\n  where\n} from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport Card from '../ui/Card';\nimport { \n  MessageSquare, \n  Send, \n  User, \n  Clock, \n  Eye, \n  XCircle,\n  Paperclip,\n  Smile,\n  MoreHorizontal,\n  Phone,\n  Mail,\n  MapPin,\n  Briefcase\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface Message {\n  id: string;\n  senderId: string;\n  senderName: string;\n  message: string;\n  timestamp: any;\n  applicationId: string;\n  read: boolean;\n}\n\ninterface ApplicationMessagingProps {\n  applicationId: string;\n  onClose?: () =\u003e void;\n  isModal?: boolean;\n}\n\nconst ApplicationMessaging: React.FC\u003cApplicationMessagingProps\u003e = ({ \n  applicationId, \n  onClose, \n  isModal = false \n}) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cany\u003e(null);\n  const [applicantProfile, setApplicantProfile] = useState\u003cany\u003e(null);\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState\u003cMessage[]\u003e([]);\n  const [newMessage, setNewMessage] = useState('');\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSendingMessage, setIsSendingMessage] = useState(false);\n  const messagesEndRef = useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n      subscribeToMessages();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    scrollToBottom();\n  }, [messages]);\n\n  const scrollToBottom = () =\u003e {\n    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n  };\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          });\n        }\n\n        // Load applicant profile\n        try {\n          const profileQuery = query(\n            collection(db, 'crewProfiles'),\n            where('uid', '==', applicationData.applicantId)\n          );\n          const profileSnapshot = await getDocs(profileQuery);\n          \n          if (!profileSnapshot.empty) {\n            const profileData = profileSnapshot.docs[0].data();\n            setApplicantProfile({\n              uid: profileData.uid || applicationData.applicantId,\n              name: profileData.name || 'Unknown Applicant',\n              username: profileData.username || profileData.name?.toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, '') || 'unknown',\n              bio: profileData.bio || '',\n              jobTitles: profileData.jobTitles || [],\n              experience: profileData.experience || 'Not specified',\n              location: profileData.location || 'Not specified',\n              skills: profileData.skills || [],\n              availability: profileData.availability || 'Not specified',\n              phone: profileData.phone,\n              email: profileData.email\n            });\n          } else {\n            setApplicantProfile({\n              uid: applicationData.applicantId,\n              name: 'Unknown Applicant',\n              username: 'unknown',\n              bio: 'Profile not available',\n              jobTitles: [],\n              experience: 'Not specified',\n              location: 'Not specified',\n              skills: [],\n              availability: 'Not specified'\n            });\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('Error loading applicant profile:', error);\n          setApplicantProfile({\n            uid: applicationData.applicantId,\n            name: 'Unknown Applicant',\n            username: 'unknown',\n            bio: 'Profile not available',\n            jobTitles: [],\n            experience: 'Not specified',\n            location: 'Not specified',\n            skills: [],\n            availability: 'Not specified'\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to load application details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const subscribeToMessages = () =\u003e {\n    const messagesQuery = query(\n      collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'messages'),\n      orderBy('timestamp', 'asc'),\n      limit(100)\n    );\n    \n    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(messagesQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const messagesData = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n        id: doc.id,\n        ...doc.data()\n      })) as Message[];\n      setMessages(messagesData);\n    });\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  };\n\n  const sendMessage = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!newMessage.trim() || !application || !currentUser) return;\n\n    // Defensive: ensure applicationId is a string and matches parent\n    if (!applicationId || typeof applicationId !== 'string') {\n      toast.error('Invalid application ID');\n      console.error('Invalid applicationId:', applicationId);\n      return;\n    }\n    if (!currentUser.uid) {\n      toast.error('User not authenticated');\n      console.error('No currentUser.uid');\n      return;\n    }\n    // Check parent document existence\n    try {\n      const parentDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (!parentDoc.exists()) {\n        toast.error('Application does not exist. Cannot send message.');\n        console.error('Parent jobApplications doc does not exist:', applicationId);\n        return;\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      toast.error('Error checking application existence');\n      console.error('Error checking parent doc existence:', err);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const messageData = {\n      senderId: currentUser.uid,\n      senderName: currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email || 'Unknown User',\n      message: newMessage.trim(),\n      timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n      applicationId: applicationId,\n      read: false\n    };\n\n    try {\n      console.log('Attempting to send message:', messageData);\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId, 'messages'), messageData);\n      // Create notification for the recipient\n      const jobPostingRef = doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId);\n      const jobPostingSnap = await getDoc(jobPostingRef);\n      const jobPosting = jobPostingSnap.data();\n      // Determine recipient: if sender is applicant, recipient is job poster; else recipient is applicant\n      const recipientId = currentUser.uid === application.applicantId ? jobPosting?.postedById : application.applicantId;\n      if (recipientId) {\n        await addDoc(collection(db, 'users', recipientId, 'notifications'), {\n          type: 'application_message',\n          message: &#96;New message from ${currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email} regarding job application&#96;,\n          timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n          read: false,\n          userId: recipientId,\n          relatedId: applicationId,\n          applicationId: applicationId,\n          senderId: currentUser.uid,\n          extra: {\n            applicationId: applicationId,\n            senderName: currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email\n          }\n        });\n      }\n      setNewMessage('');\n      toast.success('Message sent successfully!');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending message:', error, '\\nMessage data:', messageData, '\\napplicationId:', applicationId, '\\ncurrentUser:', currentUser);\n      toast.error('Failed to send message. Please try again.');\n    } finally {\n      setIsSendingMessage(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleString();\n  };\n\n  const isCurrentUser = (senderId: string) =\u003e {\n    return senderId === currentUser?.uid;\n  };\n\n  if (isLoading) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-center p-8\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading messages...\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (!application || !job) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"text-center p-8\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-6xl mb-4 opacity-20\"\u003e❌\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003ch2 className=\"text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003eApplication Not Found\u003c/h2\u003e\n        \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 mb-4\"\u003eThe application you're looking for doesn't exist.\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003cButton onClick={() =\u003e navigate('/applications')}\u003e\n          Back to Applications\n        \u003c/Button\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }\n\n  const content = (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"flex flex-col h-full\"\u003e\n      {/* Header */}\n      \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white rounded-t-lg\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-3\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"w-10 h-10 bg-blue-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center\"\u003e\n            \u003cUser className=\"w-5 h-5 text-blue-600\" /\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003cdiv\u003e\n            \u003ch3 className=\"font-semibold text-gray-900\"\u003e\n              {applicantProfile?.name || 'Unknown Applicant'}\n            \u003c/h3\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003e\n              {job.title} • {job.department}\n            \u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n        \n        \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"\u003e\n          {isModal \u0026\u0026 onClose \u0026\u0026 (\n            \u003cButton variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={onClose}\u003e\n              \u003cXCircle className=\"w-4 h-4\" /\u003e\n            \u003c/Button\u003e\n          )}\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n\n      {/* Messages */}\n      \u003cdiv className=\"flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 bg-gray-50\"\u003e\n        {messages.length === 0 ? (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-8\"\u003e\n            \u003cMessageSquare className=\"w-12 h-12 text-gray-300 mx-auto mb-4\" /\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 mb-2\"\u003eNo messages yet\u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\"\u003eStart a conversation about this application\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        ) : (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"space-y-3\"\u003e\n            {messages.map((message) =\u003e (\n              \u003cdiv key={message.id} className={&#96;flex ${isCurrentUser(message.senderId) ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}&#96;}\u003e\n                \u003cdiv className={&#96;max-w-xs lg:max-w-md px-4 py-2 rounded-lg ${\n                  isCurrentUser(message.senderId)\n                    ? 'bg-blue-500 text-white'\n                    : 'bg-white text-gray-900 border border-gray-200'\n                }&#96;}\u003e\n                  \u003cdiv className={&#96;text-xs mb-1 ${\n                    isCurrentUser(message.senderId) ? 'text-blue-100' : 'text-gray-500'\n                  }&#96;}\u003e\n                    {message.senderName} • {formatDate(message.timestamp)}\n                  \u003c/div\u003e\n                  \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap\"\u003e{message.message}\u003c/div\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            ))}\n            \u003cdiv ref={messagesEndRef} /\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n\n      {/* Message Input */}\n      \u003cdiv className=\"p-4 border-t border-gray-200 bg-white rounded-b-lg\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"flex gap-2\"\u003e\n          \u003cinput\n            type=\"text\"\n            className=\"flex-1 px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 transition-all\"\n            placeholder=\"Type a message...\"\n            value={newMessage}\n            onChange={(e) =\u003e setNewMessage(e.target.value)}\n            onKeyDown={(e) =\u003e { if (e.key === 'Enter' \u0026\u0026 !e.shiftKey) sendMessage(); }}\n            disabled={isSendingMessage}\n          /\u003e\n          \u003cButton \n            onClick={sendMessage} \n            disabled={isSendingMessage || !newMessage.trim()}\n            className=\"px-4 py-2\"\n          \u003e\n            \u003cSend className=\"w-4 h-4\" /\u003e\n          \u003c/Button\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n\n  if (isModal) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4\" onClick={onClose}\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-xl max-w-2xl w-full max-h-[80vh] flex flex-col\" onClick={(e) =\u003e e.stopPropagation()}\u003e\n          {content}\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cCard className=\"h-[600px] flex flex-col\"\u003e\n      {content}\n    \u003c/Card\u003e\n  );\n};\n\nexport default ApplicationMessaging;       "contents": "import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { collection, query, where, getDocs, doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { JobApplicationService } from '../../utilities/jobApplicationService';\nimport ApplicationStatusBadge, { ApplicationStatus } from './ApplicationStatusBadge';\nimport Card, { CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '../ui/Card';\n\ninterface JobPostingSummary {\n  id: string;\n  title: string;\n  companyName?: string;\n  department?: string;\n  location?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  postedAt?: any;\n}\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 py-12 px-4 md:px-8\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"max-w-4xl mx-auto\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"mb-8 flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n          \u003ch1 className=\"text-3xl font-light text-gray-900\"\u003eJobs You've Applied To\u003c/h1\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cLink to=\"/applications/dashboard\" className=\"text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm\"\u003e\n              View Dashboard\n            \u003c/Link\u003e\n            \u003cLink to=\"/jobs\" className=\"text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm\"\u003e← Back to Job Search\u003c/Link\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n        {isLoading ? (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-12\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading applied jobs...\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        ) : appliedJobs.length === 0 ? (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-12\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-6xl mb-4 opacity-20\"\u003e📝\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003ch3 className=\"text-xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003eNo applications yet\u003c/h3\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600\"\u003eJobs you apply to will appear here.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        ) : (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6\"\u003e\n            {appliedJobs.map(({ application, job }) =\u003e {\n              // Create enhanced status object\n              const enhancedStatus: ApplicationStatus = {\n                status: application.status || 'pending',\n                lastUpdated: application.lastUpdated?.toDate(),\n                timeline: {\n                  applied: application.appliedAt?.toDate() || new Date(),\n                  reviewed: application.reviewedAt?.toDate(),\n                  shortlisted: application.reviewedAt?.toDate(), // Use reviewedAt for shortlisted\n                  interviewed: application.interviewScheduled?.toDate(),\n                  decision: application.lastUpdated?.toDate(),\n                },\n                notes: application.notes,\n                nextStep: application.interviewNotes\n              };\n\n              return (\n                \u003cCard key={application.id} variant=\"elevated\" hoverable className=\"flex flex-col\"\u003e\n                  \u003cCardBody className=\"p-6 flex flex-col justify-between\"\u003e\n                    \u003cdiv className=\"mb-4\"\u003e\n                      \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-start justify-between mb-3\"\u003e\n                        \u003cCardTitle className=\"text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors truncate\"\u003e\n                          \u003cLink to={job ?       "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplicationService } from '../../utilities/jobApplicationService';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport Card, { CardHeader, CardBody, CardTitle } from '../ui/Card';\nimport { \n  TrendingUp, \n  TrendingDown, \n  Calendar, \n  Clock, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle,\n  BarChart3,\n  PieChart,\n  Activity,\n  Target,\n  Award,\n  Clock3\n} from 'lucide-react';\nimport { collection, query, where, getDocs } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\n\ninterface JobPostingSummary {\n  id: string;\n  title: string;\n  companyName?: string;\n  department?: string;\n  location?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  postedAt?: any;\n}\n\ninterface ApplicationWithJob {\n  application: JobApplication;\n  job: JobPostingSummary | null;\n}\n\ninterface AnalyticsData {\n  totalApplications: number;\n  successRate: number;\n  averageResponseTime: number;\n  statusBreakdown: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n  monthlyTrends: Array\u003c{ month: string; count: number }\u003e;\n  topCompanies: Array\u003c{ company: string; count: number }\u003e;\n  topDepartments: Array\u003c{ department: string; count: number }\u003e;\n  responseTimeByStatus: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n  conversionRates: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e;\n}\n\nconst ApplicationAnalytics: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cApplicationWithJob[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState\u003c'30d' | '90d' | '6m' | '1y'\u003e('90d');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDocs(query(\n            collection(db, 'jobPostings'),\n            where('__name__', '==', app.jobId)\n          ));\n          \n          if (!jobDoc.empty) {\n            const jobData = jobDoc.docs[0].data();\n            return {\n              application: app,\n              job: {\n                id: jobDoc.docs[0].id,\n                title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n                companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n                department: jobData.department || '',\n                location: jobData.location || '',\n                status: jobData.status || '',\n                postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n              } as JobPostingSummary\n            };\n          }\n          \n          return { application: app, job: null };\n        }));\n        \n        setApplications(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applications:', error);\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);\n\n  const analyticsData = useMemo((): AnalyticsData =\u003e {\n    if (applications.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        totalApplications: 0,\n        successRate: 0,\n        averageResponseTime: 0,\n        statusBreakdown: {},\n        monthlyTrends: [],\n        topCompanies: [],\n        topDepartments: [],\n        responseTimeByStatus: {},\n        conversionRates: {}\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Filter by time range\n    const now = new Date();\n    const timeRangeDays = {\n      '30d': 30,\n      '90d': 90,\n      '6m': 180,\n      '1y': 365\n    };\n    const cutoffDate = new Date(now.getTime() - timeRangeDays[timeRange] * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n    \n    const filteredApplications = applications.filter(app =\u003e {\n      const appliedDate = app.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n      return appliedDate \u003e= cutoffDate;\n    });\n\n    // Status breakdown\n    const statusBreakdown: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      const status = app.application.status || 'pending';\n      statusBreakdown[status] = (statusBreakdown[status] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n\n    // Success rate (hired / total)\n    const totalApplications = filteredApplications.length;\n    const hiredCount = statusBreakdown['hired'] || 0;\n    const successRate = totalApplications \u003e 0 ? (hiredCount / totalApplications) * 100 : 0;\n\n    // Average response time\n    const responseTimes: number[] = [];\n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      if (app.application.reviewedAt \u0026\u0026 app.application.appliedAt) {\n        const appliedDate = app.application.appliedAt.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n        const reviewedDate = app.application.reviewedAt.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n        const responseTime = (reviewedDate.getTime() - appliedDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24); // days\n        if (responseTime \u003e 0) {\n          responseTimes.push(responseTime);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n    const averageResponseTime = responseTimes.length \u003e 0 \n      ? responseTimes.reduce((sum, time) =\u003e sum + time, 0) / responseTimes.length \n      : 0;\n\n    // Monthly trends\n    const monthlyData: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      const appliedDate = app.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n      const monthKey = &#96;${appliedDate.getFullYear()}-${String(appliedDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}&#96;;\n      monthlyData[monthKey] = (monthlyData[monthKey] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n    const monthlyTrends = Object.entries(monthlyData)\n      .map(([month, count]) =\u003e ({ month, count }))\n      .sort((a, b) =\u003e a.month.localeCompare(b.month));\n\n    // Top companies\n    const companyCounts: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      const company = app.job?.companyName || 'Unknown';\n      companyCounts[company] = (companyCounts[company] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n    const topCompanies = Object.entries(companyCounts)\n      .map(([company, count]) =\u003e ({ company, count }))\n      .sort((a, b) =\u003e b.count - a.count)\n      .slice(0, 5);\n\n    // Top departments\n    const departmentCounts: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      const department = app.job?.department || 'Unknown';\n      departmentCounts[department] = (departmentCounts[department] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n    const topDepartments = Object.entries(departmentCounts)\n      .map(([department, count]) =\u003e ({ department, count }))\n      .sort((a, b) =\u003e b.count - a.count)\n      .slice(0, 5);\n\n    // Response time by status\n    const responseTimeByStatus: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    const statusResponseTimes: Record\u003cstring, number[]\u003e = {};\n    \n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      const status = app.application.status || 'pending';\n      if (app.application.reviewedAt \u0026\u0026 app.application.appliedAt) {\n        const appliedDate = app.application.appliedAt.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n        const reviewedDate = app.application.reviewedAt.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n        const responseTime = (reviewedDate.getTime() - appliedDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);\n        if (responseTime \u003e 0) {\n          if (!statusResponseTimes[status]) statusResponseTimes[status] = [];\n          statusResponseTimes[status].push(responseTime);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    Object.entries(statusResponseTimes).forEach(([status, times]) =\u003e {\n      responseTimeByStatus[status] = times.reduce((sum, time) =\u003e sum + time, 0) / times.length;\n    });\n\n    // Conversion rates\n    const conversionRates: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    const statusTransitions: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    \n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      const status = app.application.status || 'pending';\n      statusTransitions[status] = (statusTransitions[status] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n\n    const total = Object.values(statusTransitions).reduce((sum, count) =\u003e sum + count, 0);\n    Object.entries(statusTransitions).forEach(([status, count]) =\u003e {\n      conversionRates[status] = total \u003e 0 ? (count / total) * 100 : 0;\n    });\n\n    return {\n      totalApplications,\n      successRate,\n      averageResponseTime,\n      statusBreakdown,\n      monthlyTrends,\n      topCompanies,\n      topDepartments,\n      responseTimeByStatus,\n      conversionRates\n    };\n  }, [applications, timeRange]);\n\n  const getStatusColor = (status: string) =\u003e {\n    const colors = {\n      pending: 'text-yellow-600',\n      reviewed: 'text-blue-600',\n      shortlisted: 'text-purple-600',\n      interviewed: 'text-indigo-600',\n      hired: 'text-green-600',\n      rejected: 'text-red-600',\n      withdrawn: 'text-gray-600'\n    };\n    return colors[status as keyof typeof colors] || 'text-gray-600';\n  };\n\n  const getStatusIcon = (status: string) =\u003e {\n    const icons = {\n      pending: Clock,\n      reviewed: Activity,\n      shortlisted: Target,\n      interviewed: BarChart3,\n      hired: CheckCircle,\n      rejected: XCircle,\n      withdrawn: XCircle\n    };\n    return icons[status as keyof typeof icons] || Clock;\n  };\n\n  if (isLoading) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 py-12 px-4 md:px-8\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"max-w-7xl mx-auto\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-12\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading analytics...\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 py-12 px-4 md:px-8\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"max-w-7xl mx-auto\"\u003e\n        {/* Header */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"mb-8\"\u003e\n          \u003ch1 className=\"text-3xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003eApplication Analytics\u003c/h1\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600\"\u003eInsights into your job application performance\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Time Range Selector */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"mb-6\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex gap-2\"\u003e\n            {(['30d', '90d', '6m', '1y'] as const).map((range) =\u003e (\n              \u003cbutton\n                key={range}\n                onClick={() =\u003e setTimeRange(range)}\n                className={&#96;px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${\n                  timeRange === range\n                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'\n                    : 'bg-white text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200'\n                }&#96;}\n              \u003e\n                {range === '30d' ? '30 Days' : \n                 range === '90d' ? '90 Days' : \n                 range === '6m' ? '6 Months' : '1 Year'}\n              \u003c/button\u003e\n            ))}\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Key Metrics */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\"\u003e\n            \u003cCardBody className=\"p-6\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n                \u003cdiv\u003e\n                  \u003cp className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-600\"\u003eTotal Applications\u003c/p\u003e\n                  \u003cp className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900\"\u003e{analyticsData.totalApplications}\u003c/p\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n                \u003cdiv className=\"p-3 bg-blue-100 rounded-full\"\u003e\n                  \u003cBarChart3 className=\"w-6 h-6 text-blue-600\" /\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/CardBody\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\"\u003e\n            \u003cCardBody className=\"p-6\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n                \u003cdiv\u003e\n                  \u003cp className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-600\"\u003eSuccess Rate\u003c/p\u003e\n                  \u003cp className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900\"\u003e{analyticsData.successRate.toFixed(1)}%\u003c/p\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n                \u003cdiv className=\"p-3 bg-green-100 rounded-full\"\u003e\n                  \u003cAward className=\"w-6 h-6 text-green-600\" /\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/CardBody\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\"\u003e\n            \u003cCardBody className=\"p-6\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n                \u003cdiv\u003e\n                  \u003cp className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-600\"\u003eAvg Response Time\u003c/p\u003e\n                  \u003cp className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900\"\u003e\n                    {analyticsData.averageResponseTime \u003e 0 \n                      ? &#96;${analyticsData.averageResponseTime.toFixed(1)} days&#96;\n                      : 'N/A'\n                    }\n                  \u003c/p\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n                \u003cdiv className=\"p-3 bg-purple-100 rounded-full\"\u003e\n                  \u003cClock3 className=\"w-6 h-6 text-purple-600\" /\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/CardBody\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\"\u003e\n            \u003cCardBody className=\"p-6\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n                \u003cdiv\u003e\n                  \u003cp className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-600\"\u003eActive Applications\u003c/p\u003e\n                  \u003cp className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900\"\u003e\n                    {(analyticsData.statusBreakdown['pending'] || 0) + \n                     (analyticsData.statusBreakdown['reviewed'] || 0) + \n                     (analyticsData.statusBreakdown['shortlisted'] || 0) + \n                     (analyticsData.statusBreakdown['interviewed'] || 0)}\n                  \u003c/p\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n                \u003cdiv className=\"p-3 bg-yellow-100 rounded-full\"\u003e\n                  \u003cActivity className=\"w-6 h-6 text-yellow-600\" /\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/CardBody\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Status Breakdown */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\"\u003e\n            \u003cCardHeader\u003e\n              \u003cCardTitle\u003eApplication Status Breakdown\u003c/CardTitle\u003e\n            \u003c/CardHeader\u003e\n            \u003cCardBody\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"space-y-4\"\u003e\n                {Object.entries(analyticsData.statusBreakdown).map(([status, count]) =\u003e {\n                  const Icon = getStatusIcon(status);\n                  const percentage = analyticsData.totalApplications \u003e 0 \n                    ? (count / analyticsData.totalApplications) * 100 \n                    : 0;\n                  \n                  return (\n                    \u003cdiv key={status} className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n                      \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-3\"\u003e\n                        \u003cIcon className={&#96;w-5 h-5 ${getStatusColor(status)}&#96;} /\u003e\n                        \u003cspan className=\"font-medium capitalize\"\u003e{status}\u003c/span\u003e\n                      \u003c/div\u003e\n                      \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-3\"\u003e\n                        \u003cdiv className=\"w-24 bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2\"\u003e\n                          \u003cdiv \n                            className=\"bg-blue-600 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300\"\n                            style={{ width: &#96;${percentage}%&#96; }}\n                          /\u003e\n                        \u003c/div\u003e\n                        \u003cspan className=\"text-sm text-gray-600 w-12 text-right\"\u003e\n                          {count} ({percentage.toFixed(1)}%)\n                        \u003c/span\u003e\n                      \u003c/div\u003e\n                    \u003c/div\u003e\n                  );\n                })}\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/CardBody\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n\n          {/* Monthly Trends */}\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\"\u003e\n            \u003cCardHeader\u003e\n              \u003cCardTitle\u003eMonthly Application Trends\u003c/CardTitle\u003e\n            \u003c/CardHeader\u003e\n            \u003cCardBody\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"space-y-3\"\u003e\n                {analyticsData.monthlyTrends.map(({ month, count }) =\u003e {\n                  const [year, monthNum] = month.split('-');\n                  const monthName = new Date(parseInt(year), parseInt(monthNum) - 1).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });\n                  \n                  return (\n                    \u003cdiv key={month} className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n                      \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-600\"\u003e{monthName}\u003c/span\u003e\n                      \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"\u003e\n                        \u003cdiv className=\"w-20 bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2\"\u003e\n                          \u003cdiv \n                            className=\"bg-green-600 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300\"\n                            style={{ \n                              width: &#96;${analyticsData.monthlyTrends.length \u003e 0 \n                                ? (count / Math.max(...analyticsData.monthlyTrends.map(m =\u003e m.count))) * 100 \n                                : 0}%&#96; \n                            }}\n                          /\u003e\n                        \u003c/div\u003e\n                        \u003cspan className=\"text-sm text-gray-600 w-8 text-right\"\u003e{count}\u003c/span\u003e\n                      \u003c/div\u003e\n                    \u003c/div\u003e\n                  );\n                })}\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/CardBody\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Top Companies and Departments */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\"\u003e\n            \u003cCardHeader\u003e\n              \u003cCardTitle\u003eTop Companies Applied To\u003c/CardTitle\u003e\n            \u003c/CardHeader\u003e\n            \u003cCardBody\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"space-y-3\"\u003e\n                {analyticsData.topCompanies.map(({ company, count }, index) =\u003e (\n                  \u003cdiv key={company} className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n                    \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-3\"\u003e\n                      \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 w-6\"\u003e#{index + 1}\u003c/span\u003e\n                      \u003cspan className=\"font-medium\"\u003e{company}\u003c/span\u003e\n                    \u003c/div\u003e\n                    \u003cspan className=\"text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003e{count} applications\u003c/span\u003e\n                  \u003c/div\u003e\n                ))}\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/CardBody\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\"\u003e\n            \u003cCardHeader\u003e\n              \u003cCardTitle\u003eTop {analyticsData.topDepartments.map(({ department, count }, index) =\u003e (\n                  \u003cdiv key={department} className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n       "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\n\nconst ApplicationSuccessPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { applicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId!));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as JobPosting);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };\n\n  if (isLoading) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading application details...\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"max-w-4xl mx-auto px-8 py-16\"\u003e\n        {/* Success Header */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center mb-12\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"w-24 h-24 bg-green-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-4xl\"\u003e✅\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          \u003ch1 className=\"text-4xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-4 tracking-tight\"\u003e\n            Application Submitted!\n          \u003c/h1\u003e\n          \n          \u003cp className=\"text-xl font-light text-gray-600 max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed\"\u003e\n            Your application has been successfully submitted. We'll review it and get back to you soon.\n          \u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Application Summary */}\n        {application \u0026\u0026 job \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-8 mb-8\"\u003e\n            \u003ch2 className=\"text-2xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-6\"\u003eApplication Summary\u003c/h2\u003e\n            \n            \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv\u003e\n                \u003ch3 className=\"text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 mb-4\"\u003eJob Details\u003c/h3\u003e\n                \u003cdiv className=\"space-y-3\"\u003e\n                  \u003cdiv\u003e\n                    \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\"\u003ePosition\u003c/span\u003e\n                    \u003cp className=\"text-gray-900\"\u003e{job.title}\u003c/p\u003e\n      \u003cp className=\"text-gray-900\"\u003e{job.department}\u003c/p\u003e\n                  \u003c/div\u003e\n                  \n                  \u003cdiv\u003e\n                    \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\"\u003eLocation\u003c/span\u003e\n                    \u003cp className=\"text-gray-900\"\u003e{job.location}\u003c/p\u003e\n                  \u003c/div\u003e\n                  \n                  {job.salary \u0026\u0026 (\n                    \u003cdiv\u003e\n                      \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\"\u003eSalary Range\u003c/span\u003e\n                      \u003cp className=\"text-gray-900\"\u003e\n                        ${job.salary.min.toLocaleString()} - ${job.salary.max.toLocaleString()}\n                      \u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003c/div\u003e\n                  )}\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n              \n              \u003cdiv\u003e\n                \u003ch3 className=\"text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 mb-4\"\u003eApplication Details\u003c/h3\u003e\n                \u003cdiv className=\"space-y-3\"\u003e\n                  \u003cdiv\u003e\n                    \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\"\u003eApplication ID\u003c/span\u003e\n                    \u003cp className=\"text-gray-900 font-mono text-sm\"\u003e{application.id.slice(-8)}\u003c/p\u003e\n                  \u003c/div\u003e\n                  \n                  \u003cdiv\u003e\n                    \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\"\u003eSubmitted\u003c/span\u003e\n                    \u003cp className=\"text-gray-900\"\u003e{formatDate(application.appliedAt)}\u003c/p\u003e\n                  \u003c/div\u003e\n                  \n                  \u003cdiv\u003e\n                    \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\"\u003eStatus\u003c/span\u003e\n                    \u003cspan className=\"px-3 py-1 bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 text-xs font-medium rounded-full\"\u003e\n                      ⏳ Pending Review\n                    \u003c/span\u003e\n                  \u003c/div\u003e\n                  \n                  {application.expectedSalary \u0026\u0026 (\n                    \u003cdiv\u003e\n                      \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\"\u003eExpected Salary\u003c/span\u003e\n                      \u003cp className=\"text-gray-900\"\u003e${application.expectedSalary.toLocaleString()}\u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003c/div\u003e\n                  )}\n                  \n                  {application.availabilityDate \u0026\u0026 (\n                    \u003cdiv\u003e\n                      \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\"\u003eAvailable From\u003c/span\u003e\n                      \u003cp className=\"text-gray-900\"\u003e{application.availabilityDate}\u003c/p\u003e\n                    \u003c/div\u003e\n                  )}\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n\n        {/* Next Steps */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-8 mb-8\"\u003e\n          \u003ch2 className=\"text-2xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-6\"\u003eWhat Happens \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003ch3 className=\"text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003eReview\u003c/h3\u003e\n              \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 text-sm\"\u003e\n                Our team will review your application and qualifications within 3-5 business days.\n              \u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n            \n            \u003cdiv   \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 text-sm\"\u003e\n                You'll receive an email update about your application status and next steps.\n              \u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n            \n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-center\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"w-16 h-16 bg-purple-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto experience.\n              \u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Action Buttons */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"flex       "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, updateDoc, increment, setDoc, serverTimestamp, deleteDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport FirebaseDiagnostic from './FirebaseDiagnostic';\nimport { SavedJobsService } from '../../utilities/savedJobsService';\n\nconst JobDetailPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const auth = useAuth();\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false);\n  const [hasApplied, setHasApplied] = useState(false);\n  const [isViewingStats, setIsViewingStats] = useState(false);\n  const [connectionStatus, setConnectionStatus] = useState\u003c'connected' | 'connecting' | 'error'\u003e('connected');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n      // View tracking disabled to eliminate Firebase connection errors\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async (retryCount = 0) =\u003e {\n    if (!jobId) {\n      setError('No job ID provided');\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n      setConnectionStatus('connecting');\n      \n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId));\n      \n      if (!jobDoc.exists()) {\n        throw new Error('Job not found');\n      }\n      \n      const data = jobDoc.data();\n      \n      // Map the Firestore document to the JobPosting interface\n      const jobData: JobPosting = {\n        id: jobDoc.id,\n        title: data.title || '',\n        department: data.department || '',\n        jobTitle: data.title || '',\n        description: data.description || '',\n        requirements: typeof data.requirements === 'string' ? [data.requirements] : \n                     Array.isArray(data.requirements) ? data.requirements : [],\n        responsibilities: typeof data.responsibilities === 'string' ? [data.responsibilities] :\n                         Array.isArray(data.responsibilities) ? data.responsibilities : [],\n        location: data.location || '',\n        startDate: data.startDate || '',\n        endDate: data.deadline || data.endDate || '',\n        salary: {\n          min: data.salaryMin || 0,\n          max: data.salaryMax || 0,\n          currency: 'USD'\n        },\n        isRemote: data.isRemote || false,\n        isUrgent: data.isUrgent || false,\n        postedById: data.postedById || '',\n        postedAt: data.createdAt?.toDate() || new Date(),\n        deadline: data.deadline || '',\n        status: data.status || 'published',\n        applicationsCount: data.applicationCount || 0,\n        tags: Array.isArray(data.skills) ? data.skills : [],\n        experienceLevel: data.experienceLevel || 'entry',\n        contractType: data.jobType || 'full_time',\n        benefits: Array.isArray(data.benefits) ? data.benefits : \n                 typeof data.benefits === 'string' ? [data.benefits] : [],\n        perks: [],\n        views: data.views || 0,\n        saves: data.saves || 0,\n        shares: data.shares || 0,\n        shortlistedCount: data.shortlistedCount || 0,\n        interviewedCount: data.interviewedCount || 0,\n        hiredCount: data.hiredCount || 0,\n        projectId: data.projectId || '',\n        contactName: data.contactName || '',\n        contactEmail: data.contactEmail || '',\n        showContactEmail: data.showContactEmail || false,\n        projectName: data.projectName || '',\n        projectType: data.projectType || 'other',\n        isPaid: data.isPaid !== undefined ? data.isPaid : true,\n        isUnion: data.isUnion || false,\n        visaSponsorship: data.visaSponsorship || false,\n        relocationAssistance: data.relocationAssistance || false\n      };\n      \n      setJob(jobData);\n      setConnectionStatus('connected');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      \n      // Handle specific error types\n      if (error.code === 'unavailable' || error.code === 'deadline-exceeded') {\n        if (retryCount \u003c 3) {\n          console.log(&#96;Retrying job details load (attempt ${retryCount + 1})...&#96;);\n          setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n            loadJobDetails(retryCount + 1);\n          }, 2000 * (retryCount + 1)); // Exponential backoff\n          return;\n        } else {\n          setError('Connection issue. Please check your internet connection and try again.');\n          setConnectionStatus('error');\n        }\n      } else if (error.code === 'permission-denied') {\n        setError('You don\\'t have permission to view this job.');\n      } else if (error.code === 'not-found') {\n        setError('Job not found. It may have been removed or is no longer available.');\n      } else {\n        setError('Failed to load job details. Please try again.');\n      }\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const incrementJobViews = async () =\u003e {\n    // Completely disable view tracking to eliminate Firebase connection errors\n    // This functionality is not critical for the user experience\n    return;\n  };\n\n  // Check if user has already saved this job\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    // Reset saved state when user or job changes\n    setIsSaved(false);\n    \n    if (auth.currentUser \u0026\u0026 jobId) {\n      const savedJobRef = doc(db, 'savedJobs', &#96;${auth.currentUser.uid}_${jobId}&#96;);\n      \n      // Use a more robust approach to check saved status\n      const checkSavedStatus = async () =\u003e {\n        try {\n          console.log('🔍 Checking saved status for user:', auth.currentUser?.uid, 'job:', jobId);\n          console.log('📄 Document path:', savedJobRef.path);\n          \n          const docSnap = await getDoc(savedJobRef);\n          const exists = docSnap.exists();\n          console.log('✅ Saved job exists:', exists);\n          setIsSaved(exists);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.error('❌ Error checking saved status:', error);\n          console.error('🔍 Error code:', error.code);\n          console.error('🔍 Error message:', error.message);\n          \n          // Don't show error to user, just assume not saved\n          setIsSaved(false);\n          \n          // Handle specific permission errors gracefully\n          if (error.code === 'permission-denied') {\n            console.log('⚠️ Permission denied for saved job check - this is expected for new users');\n          }\n        }\n      };\n      \n      checkSavedStatus();\n    }\n  }, [auth.currentUser, jobId]);\n\n  const handleSaveJob = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!auth.currentUser) {\n      toast.error('Please log in to save jobs');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      if (isSaved) {\n        // Remove from saved\n        const { savedJobId } = await SavedJobsService.isJobSaved(auth.currentUser.uid, jobId!);\n        if (savedJobId) {\n          await SavedJobsService.removeSavedJob(savedJobId);\n          setIsSaved(false);\n          toast.success('Job removed from saved');\n        }\n      } else {\n        // Add to saved\n        await SavedJobsService.saveJob(auth.currentUser.uid, jobId!);\n        setIsSaved(true);\n        toast.success('Job saved successfully');\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('Error saving job:', error);\n      \n      // Handle connection issues\n      if (error.code === 'unavailable' || error.code === 'deadline-exceeded') {\n        toast.error('Connection issue. Please try again.');\n      } else {\n        toast.error('Failed to save job. Please try again.');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleShareJob = async () =\u003e {\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${window.location.origin}/jobs/${jobId}&#96;;\n    \n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: job?.title || 'Check out this job',\n          text: &#96;I found this great opportunity: ${job?.title}&#96;,\n          url: shareUrl\n         "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  \n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState\u003cJobApplicationFormData\u003e({\n    coverLetter: '',\n    expectedSalary: undefined,\n    availabilityDate: '',\n    notes: '',\n    resumeFile: null,\n    resumeUploaded: null,\n    attachments: [],\n    attachmentsUploaded: []\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId!));\n      \n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        setJob({\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting);\n      } else {\n        setError('Job not found');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      setError('Failed to load job details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof JobApplicationFormData, value: any) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      [field]: value\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (files: File[]) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      attachments: [...prev.attachments, ...files]\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =\u003e {\n    // All fields are now optional - just check if user is authenticated\n    if (!currentUser) {\n      setError('You must be logged in to apply');\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  };",

just check if user is authenticated\n    if (!currentUser) {\n      setError('You must be logged in to apply');\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  };",

        "contents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "contents": "\n\nconst ApplicationStatusTracker: React.FC\u003cApplicationStatusTrackerProps\u003e = ({ applicationId }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { applicationId: urlApplicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null); // Changed to any for now as JobPosting type is removed\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [showMessaging, setShowMessaging] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as any); // Changed to any for now\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst ApplicationAnalytics: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cApplicationWithJob[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState\u003c'30d' | '90d' | '6m' | '1y'\u003e('90d');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDocs(query(\n            collection(db, 'jobPostings'),\n            where('__name__', '==', app.jobId)\n          ));\n          \n          if (!jobDoc.empty) {\n            const jobData = jobDoc.docs[0].data();\n            return {\n              application: app,\n              job: {\n                id: jobDoc.docs[0].id,\n                title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n                companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n                department: jobData.department || '',\n                location: jobData.location || '',\n                status: jobData.status || '',\n                postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n              } as JobPostingSummary\n            };\n          }\n          \n          return { application: app, job: null };\n        }));\n        \n        setApplications(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applications:', error);\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, collection, query, where, getDocs, updateDoc, addDoc, serverTimestamp, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { FileUploadService } from '../../utilities/fileUploadService';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport Card from '../ui/Card';\nimport ApplicationMessaging from './ApplicationMessaging';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Star, \n  Heart, \n  Eye, \n  Calendar,\n  MapPin,\n  DollarSign,\n  Briefcase,\n  Clock,\n  Phone,\n  Mail,\n  ExternalLink,\n  Filter,\n  Search,\n  MoreHorizontal,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Award,\n  TrendingUp,\n  Download,\n  FileText,\n  Paperclip\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface ApplicantProfile {\n  uid: string;\n  name: string;\n  username: string;\n  bio: string;\n  jobTitles: string[];\n  experience: string;\n  location: string;\n  skills: string[];\n  availability: string;\n  expectedSalary?: number;\n  portfolio?: string;\n  phone?: string;\n  email?: string;\n}",
