        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  \n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState\u003cJobApplicationFormData\u003e({\n    coverLetter: '',\n    expectedSalary: undefined,\n    availabilityDate: '',\n    notes: '',\n    resumeFile: null,\n    resumeUploaded: null,\n    attachments: [],\n    attachmentsUploaded: []\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId!));\n      \n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        setJob({\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting);\n      } else {\n        setError('Job not found');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      setError('Failed to load job details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof JobApplicationFormData, value: any) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      [field]: value\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (files: File[]) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      attachments: [...prev.attachments, ...files]\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =\u003e {\n    // All fields are now optional - useState\u003cJobWithApplications[]\u003e([]);\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cJobPosterStats\u003e({\n    totalJobs: 0,\n    activeJobs: 0,\n    totalApplications: 0,\n    pendingApplications: 0,\n    avgApplicationsPerJob: 0,\n    totalViews: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | pendingApplications: 0,\n    avgApplicationsPerJob: 0,\n    totalViews: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | calculateStats();\n  }, [postedJobs]);\n\n  const loadPostedJobs = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // Get jobs posted by current user         "originalContents": "\n\nconst ApplicationAnalytics: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cApplicationWithJob[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState\u003c'30d' | '90d' | '6m' | '1y'\u003e('90d');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDocs(query(\n            collection(db, 'jobPostings'),\n            where('__name__', '==', app.jobId)\n          ));\n          \n          if (!jobDoc.empty) {\n            const jobData = jobDoc.docs[0].data();\n            return {\n              application: app,\n              job: {\n                id: jobDoc.docs[0].id,\n                title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n                companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n                department: jobData.department || '',\n                location: jobData.location || '',\n                status: jobData.status || '',\n                postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n              } as JobPostingSummary\n            };\n          }\n          \n          return { application: app, job: null };\n        }));\n        \n        setApplications(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applications:', error);\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "contents": "\n\nconst ApplicationStatusTracker: React.FC\u003cApplicationStatusTrackerProps\u003e = ({ applicationId }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { applicationId: urlApplicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null); // Changed to any for now as JobPosting type is removed\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [showMessaging, setShowMessaging] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as any); // Changed to any for now\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, collection, query, where, getDocs, updateDoc, addDoc, serverTimestamp, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { FileUploadService } from '../../utilities/fileUploadService';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport Card from '../ui/Card';\nimport ApplicationMessaging from './ApplicationMessaging';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Star, \n  Heart, \n  Eye, \n  Calendar,\n  MapPin,\n  DollarSign,\n  Briefcase,\n  Clock,\n  Phone,\n  Mail,\n  ExternalLink,\n  Filter,\n  Search,\n  MoreHorizontal,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Award,\n  TrendingUp,\n  Download,\n  FileText,\n  Paperclip\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface ApplicantProfile {\n  uid: string;\n  name: string;\n  username: string;\n  bio: string;\n  jobTitles: string[];\n  experience: string;\n  location: string;\n  skills: string[];\n  availability: string;\n  expectedSalary?: number;\n  portfolio?: string;\n  phone?: string;\n  email?: string;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  \n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState\u003cJobApplicationFormData\u003e({\n    coverLetter: '',\n    expectedSalary: undefined,\n    availabilityDate: '',\n    notes: '',\n    resumeFile: null,\n    resumeUploaded: null,\n    attachments: [],\n    attachmentsUploaded: []\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId!));\n      \n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        setJob({\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting);\n      } else {\n        setError('Job not found');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      setError('Failed to load job details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof JobApplicationFormData, value: any) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      [field]: value\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (files: File[]) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      attachments: [...prev.attachments, ...files]\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =\u003e {\n    // All fields are now optional - just check if user is authenticated\n    if (!currentUser) {\n      setError('You must be logged in to apply');\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  };",

        "contents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const handleDownloadFile = (url: string, fileName: string) =\u003e {\n    const link = document.createElement('a');\n    link.href = url;\n    link.download = fileName;\n    link.target = '_blank';\n    document.body.appendChild(link);\n    link.click();\n    document.body.removeChild(link);\n  };\n\n  const handleViewFile = (url: string) =\u003e {\n    window.open(url, '_blank');\n  };\n\n  const filteredAndSortedApplications = applications\n    .filter(app =\u003e {\n      const matchesStatus = filterStatus === 'all' || app.status === filterStatus;\n      const matchesSearch = searchQuery === '' || \n        applicantProfiles[app.applicantId]?.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||\n        applicantProfiles[app.applicantId]?.jobTitles.some(title =\u003e \n          title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())\n        );\n      return matchesStatus \u0026\u0026 matchesSearch;\n    })\n    .sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n      switch (sortBy) {\n        case 'name':\n          return applicantProfiles[a.applicantId]?.name.localeCompare(applicantProfiles[b.applicantId]?.name || '');\n        case 'status':\n          return a.status.localeCompare(b.status);\n        case 'date':\n        default:\n          return (b.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(b.appliedAt)).getTime() - \n                 (a.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(a.appliedAt)).getTime();\n      }\n    });\n\n  if (isLoading) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading applicants...\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }",

        "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\n\nconst ApplicationSuccessPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { applicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId!));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as JobPosting);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\n\nconst ApplicationSuccessPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { applicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId!));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as JobPosting);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };",

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "contents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "contents": "\n\nconst ApplicationStatusTracker: React.FC\u003cApplicationStatusTrackerProps\u003e = ({ applicationId }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { applicationId: urlApplicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null); // Changed to any for now as JobPosting type is removed\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [showMessaging, setShowMessaging] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as any); // Changed to any for now\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst ApplicationStatusTracker: React.FC\u003cApplicationStatusTrackerProps\u003e = ({ applicationId }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { applicationId: urlApplicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null); // Changed to any for now as JobPosting type is removed\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [showMessaging, setShowMessaging] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as any); // Changed to any for now\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, collection, query, where, getDocs, updateDoc, addDoc, serverTimestamp, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { FileUploadService } from '../../utilities/fileUploadService';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport Card from '../ui/Card';\nimport ApplicationMessaging from './ApplicationMessaging';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Star, \n  Heart, \n  Eye, \n  Calendar,\n  MapPin,\n  DollarSign,\n  Briefcase,\n  Clock,\n  Phone,\n  Mail,\n  ExternalLink,\n  Filter,\n  Search,\n  MoreHorizontal,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Award,\n  TrendingUp,\n  Download,\n  FileText,\n  Paperclip\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface ApplicantProfile {\n  uid: string;\n  name: string;\n  username: string;\n  bio: string;\n  jobTitles: string[];\n  experience: string;\n  location: string;\n  skills: string[];\n  availability: string;\n  expectedSalary?: number;\n  portfolio?: string;\n  phone?: string;\n  email?: string;\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

'jobs' | 'applications' | 'analytics'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (currentUser) {\n      loadPostedJobs();\n    }\n  }, [currentUser]);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n         "contents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "contents": "\n\nconst ApplicationStatusTracker: React.FC\u003cApplicationStatusTrackerProps\u003e = ({ applicationId }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { applicationId: urlApplicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null); // Changed to any for now as JobPosting type is removed\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [showMessaging, setShowMessaging] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as any); // Changed to any for now\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst ApplicationStatusTracker: React.FC\u003cApplicationStatusTrackerProps\u003e = ({ applicationId }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { applicationId: urlApplicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null); // Changed to any for now as JobPosting type is removed\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [showMessaging, setShowMessaging] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as any); // Changed to any for now\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, collection, query, where, getDocs, updateDoc, addDoc, serverTimestamp, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { FileUploadService } from '../../utilities/fileUploadService';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport Card from '../ui/Card';\nimport ApplicationMessaging from './ApplicationMessaging';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Star, \n  Heart, \n  Eye, \n  Calendar,\n  MapPin,\n  DollarSign,\n  Briefcase,\n  Clock,\n  Phone,\n  Mail,\n  ExternalLink,\n  Filter,\n  Search,\n  MoreHorizontal,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Award,\n  TrendingUp,\n  Download,\n  FileText,\n  Paperclip\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface ApplicantProfile {\n  uid: string;\n  name: string;\n  username: string;\n  bio: string;\n  jobTitles: string[];\n  experience: string;\n  location: string;\n  skills: string[];\n  availability: string;\n  expectedSalary?: number;\n  portfolio?: string;\n  phone?: string;\n  email?: string;\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 20

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "contents": "\n\nconst ApplicationStatusTracker: React.FC\u003cApplicationStatusTrackerProps\u003e = ({ applicationId }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { applicationId: urlApplicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null); // Changed to any for now as JobPosting type is removed\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [showMessaging, setShowMessaging] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as any); // Changed to any for now\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst ApplicationStatusTracker: React.FC\u003cApplicationStatusTrackerProps\u003e = ({ applicationId }) =\u003e {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { applicationId: urlApplicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null); // Changed to any for now as JobPosting type is removed\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [showMessaging, setShowMessaging] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as any); // Changed to any for now\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, collection, query, where, getDocs, updateDoc, addDoc, serverTimestamp, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { FileUploadService } from '../../utilities/fileUploadService';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport Card from '../ui/Card';\nimport ApplicationMessaging from './ApplicationMessaging';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Star, \n  Heart, \n  Eye, \n  Calendar,\n  MapPin,\n  DollarSign,\n  Briefcase,\n  Clock,\n  Phone,\n  Mail,\n  ExternalLink,\n  Filter,\n  Search,\n  MoreHorizontal,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Award,\n  TrendingUp,\n  Download,\n  FileText,\n  Paperclip\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface ApplicantProfile {\n  uid: string;\n  name: string;\n  username: string;\n  bio: string;\n  jobTitles: string[];\n  experience: string;\n  location: string;\n  skills: string[];\n  availability: string;\n  expectedSalary?: number;\n  portfolio?: string;\n  phone?: string;\n  email?: string;\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

useState\u003cJobWithApplications[]\u003e([]);\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cJobPosterStats\u003e({\n    totalJobs: 0,\n    activeJobs: 0,\n    totalApplications: 0,\n    pendingApplications: 0,\n    avgApplicationsPerJob: 0,\n    totalViews: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'jobs' | 'applications' | 'analytics'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (currentUser) {\n      loadPostedJobs();\n    }\n  }, [currentUser]);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n pendingApplications: 0,\n    avgApplicationsPerJob: 0,\n    totalViews: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' |         "contents": "\n\nconst ApplicationAnalytics: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cApplicationWithJob[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState\u003c'30d' | '90d' | '6m' | '1y'\u003e('90d');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDocs(query(\n            collection(db, 'jobPostings'),\n            where('__name__', '==', app.jobId)\n          ));\n          \n          if (!jobDoc.empty) {\n            const jobData = jobDoc.docs[0].data();\n            return {\n              application: app,\n              job: {\n                id: jobDoc.docs[0].id,\n                title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n                companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n                department: jobData.department || '',\n                location: jobData.location || '',\n                status: jobData.status || '',\n                postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n              } as JobPostingSummary\n            };\n          }\n          \n          return { application: app, job: null };\n        }));\n        \n        setApplications(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applications:', error);\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\n\nconst ApplicationSuccessPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { applicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId!));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as JobPosting);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\n\nconst ApplicationSuccessPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { applicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId!));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as JobPosting);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };",

        "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, collection, query, where, getDocs, updateDoc, addDoc, serverTimestamp, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { FileUploadService } from '../../utilities/fileUploadService';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport Card from '../ui/Card';\nimport ApplicationMessaging from './ApplicationMessaging';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Star, \n  Heart, \n  Eye, \n  Calendar,\n  MapPin,\n  DollarSign,\n  Briefcase,\n  Clock,\n  Phone,\n  Mail,\n  ExternalLink,\n  Filter,\n  Search,\n  MoreHorizontal,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Award,\n  TrendingUp,\n  Download,\n  FileText,\n  Paperclip\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface ApplicantProfile {\n  uid: string;\n  name: string;\n  username: string;\n  bio: string;\n  jobTitles: string[];\n  experience: string;\n  location: string;\n  skills: string[];\n  availability: string;\n  expectedSalary?: number;\n  portfolio?: string;\n  phone?: string;\n  email?: string;\n}",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';"

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, collection, query, where, getDocs, updateDoc, addDoc, serverTimestamp, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { FileUploadService } from '../../utilities/fileUploadService';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport Card from '../ui/Card';\nimport ApplicationMessaging from './ApplicationMessaging';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Star, \n  Heart, \n  Eye, \n  Calendar,\n  MapPin,\n  DollarSign,\n  Briefcase,\n  Clock,\n  Phone,\n  Mail,\n  ExternalLink,\n  Filter,\n  Search,\n  MoreHorizontal,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Award,\n  TrendingUp,\n  Download,\n  FileText,\n  Paperclip\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface ApplicantProfile {\n  uid: string;\n  name: string;\n  username: string;\n  bio: string;\n  jobTitles: string[];\n  experience: string;\n  location: string;\n  skills: string[];\n  availability: string;\n  expectedSalary?: number;\n  portfolio?: string;\n  phone?: string;\n  email?: string;\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobPosterDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [postedJobs, setPostedJobs] = useState\u003cJobWithApplications[]\u003e([]);\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cJobPosterStats\u003e({\n    totalJobs: 0,\n    activeJobs: 0,\n    totalApplications: 0,\n    pendingApplications: 0,\n    avgApplicationsPerJob: 0,\n    totalViews: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'jobs' | 'applications' | 'analytics'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (currentUser) {\n      loadPostedJobs();\n    }\n  }, [currentUser]);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [postedJobs]);\n\n  const loadPostedJobs = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // Get jobs posted by current user (using postedById)\n      const jobsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'jobPostings'),\n        where('postedById', '==', currentUser.uid),\n        orderBy('postedAt', 'desc')\n      );\n      \n      const jobsSnapshot = await getDocs(jobsQuery);\n      const jobsData: JobWithApplications[] = [];\n      \n      // For each job, get the applications\n      for (const jobDoc of applications.length\n        });\n      }\n      \n      setPostedJobs(jobsData);\n      console.log('Loaded posted jobs:', jobsData.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading posted jobs:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to load posted jobs');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobPosterDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [postedJobs, setPostedJobs] = useState\u003cJobWithApplications[]\u003e([]);\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cJobPosterStats\u003e({\n    totalJobs: 0,\n    activeJobs: 0,\n    totalApplications: 0,\n    pendingApplications: 0,\n    avgApplicationsPerJob: 0,\n    totalViews: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | calculateStats();\n  }, [postedJobs]);\n\n  const loadPostedJobs = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // Get jobs posted by current user         "originalContents": "\n\n  const loadJobAndApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!jobId) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // Load job details\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId));\n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        const jobData = {\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting;\n        setJob(jobData);\n        \n        // Check if current user is the job poster\n        if (jobData.postedById !== currentUser?.uid) {\n          toast.error('You can only view applications for jobs you posted');\n          return;\n        }\n      } else {\n        toast.error('Job not found');\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // Load applications\n      const jobApplications = await JobApplicationService.getJobApplications(jobId);\n      setApplications(jobApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch applicant profiles\n      const applicantIds = jobApplications.map(app =\u003e app.applicantId);\n      const profilesMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};",
