        "originalContents": "\n\n  const handleDownloadFile = (url: string, fileName: string) =\u003e {\n    const link = document.createElement('a');\n    link.href = url;\n    link.download = fileName;\n    link.target = '_blank';\n    document.body.appendChild(link);\n    link.click();\n    document.body.removeChild(link);\n  };\n\n  const handleViewFile = (url: string) =\u003e {\n    window.open(url, '_blank');\n  };\n\n  const filteredAndSortedApplications = applications\n    .filter(app =\u003e {\n      const matchesStatus = filterStatus === 'all' || app.status === filterStatus;\n      const matchesSearch = searchQuery === '' || \n        applicantProfiles[app.applicantId]?.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||\n        applicantProfiles[app.applicantId]?.jobTitles.some(title =\u003e \n          title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())\n        );\n      return matchesStatus \u0026\u0026 matchesSearch;\n    })\n    .sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n      switch (sortBy) {\n        case 'name':\n          return applicantProfiles[a.applicantId]?.name.localeCompare(applicantProfiles[b.applicantId]?.name || '');\n        case 'status':\n          return a.status.localeCompare(b.status);\n        case 'date':\n        default:\n          return (b.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(b.appliedAt)).getTime() - \n                 (a.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(a.appliedAt)).getTime();\n      }\n    });\n\n  if (isLoading) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading applicants...\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }",

        "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\n\nconst ApplicationSuccessPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { applicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId!));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as JobPosting);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };",

        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobApplication, JobPosting } from '../../types/JobApplication';\n\nconst ApplicationSuccessPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { applicationId } = useParams\u003c{ applicationId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  \n  const [application, setApplication] = useState\u003cJobApplication | null\u003e(null);\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (applicationId) {\n      loadApplicationDetails();\n    }\n  }, [applicationId]);\n\n  const loadApplicationDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      \n      // Load application details\n      const applicationDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId!));\n      if (applicationDoc.exists()) {\n        const applicationData = {\n          id: applicationDoc.id,\n          ...applicationDoc.data()\n        } as JobApplication;\n        setApplication(applicationData);\n        \n        // Load job details\n        const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', applicationData.jobId));\n        if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n          setJob({\n            id: jobDoc.id,\n            ...jobDoc.data()\n          } as JobPosting);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };",

      "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { collection, query, where, orderBy, getDocs, limit, getDoc, doc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from JobApplicationService } from '../../utilities/jobApplicationService';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\n\ninterface ApplicationStats {\n  total: number;\n  pending: number;\n  accepted: number;\n  rejected: number;\n  interviewScheduled: number;\n  responseRate: number;\n  avgResponseTime: number;\n}\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteApplication = async (applicationId: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!window.confirm('Are you sure you want to withdraw this application? This action cannot be undone.')) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      await JobApplicationService.deleteApplication(applicationId);\n      toast.success('Application withdrawn successfully');\n      // Reload applications to update the list\n      loadApplications();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error deleting application:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to withdraw application');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const calculateStats = () =\u003e {\n    const total = applications.length;\n    const pending = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'pending').length;\n    const reviewed = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'reviewed').length;\n    const shortlisted = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'shortlisted').length;\n    const interviewed = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'interviewed').length;\n    const hired = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'hired').length;\n    const rejected = applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'rejected').length;\n    \n    const responseRate = total \u003e 0 ? ((reviewed + shortlisted + interviewed + hired + rejected) / total) * 100 : 0;\n    \n    // Calculate average response time using reviewedAt\n    const respondedApps = applications.filter(app =\u003e \n      app.status !== 'pending' \u0026\u0026 app.reviewedAt \u0026\u0026 app.appliedAt\n    );\n    \n    let avgResponseTime = 0;\n    if (respondedApps.length \u003e 0) {\n      const totalDays = respondedApps.reduce((sum, app) =\u003e {\n        const appliedDate = app.appliedAt?.toDate ? app.appliedAt.toDate() : new Date(app.appliedAt);\n        const reviewedDate = app.reviewedAt?.toDate ? app.reviewedAt.toDate() : new Date(app.reviewedAt);\n        return sum + (reviewedDate.getTime() - appliedDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);\n      }, 0);\n      avgResponseTime = totalDays / respondedApps.length;\n    }\n\n    setStats({\n      total,\n      pending,\n      accepted: hired, // Map hired to accepted for display\n      rejected,\n      interviewScheduled: interviewed,\n      responseRate,\n      avgResponseTime\n    });\n  };\n\n  const getStatusColor = (status: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'pending': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';\n      case 'reviewed': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';\n      case 'shortlisted': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'interviewed': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800';\n      case 'hired': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'rejected': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';\n      case 'withdrawn': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getStatusIcon = (status: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'pending': return '⏳';\n      case 'reviewed': return '👁️';\n      case 'shortlisted': return '⭐';\n      case 'interviewed': return '📅';\n      case 'hired': return '✅';\n      case 'rejected': return '❌';\n      case 'withdrawn': return '↩️';\n      default: return '📋';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };\n\n  const renderOverview = () =\u003e (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-3xl opacity-20\"\u003e⏱️\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n\n      \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-sm font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eInterviews Scheduled\u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-3xl font-light text-gray-900\"\u003e{stats.interviewScheduled}\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n (stats.accepted / stats.total) * 100 : 0}%&#96; }}\n                \u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-900\"\u003e{stats.accepted}\u003c/span\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n            \u003cspan className=\"text-gray-600\"\u003eRejected\u003c/span\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"w-32 bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2\"\u003e\n                \u003cdiv \n                  className=\"bg-red-500 h-2 rounded-full\" \n                  style={{ width: &#96;${stats.total \u003e 0 ? (stats.rejected / stats.total) * 100 : 0}%&#96; }}\n                \u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-900\"\u003e{stats.rejected}\u003c/span\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n            \u003cspan className=\"text-gray-600\"\u003eInterview Scheduled\u003c/span\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"w-32 bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2\"\u003e\n                \u003cdiv \n                  className=\"bg-purple-500 h-2 rounded-full\" \n                  style={{ width: &#96;${stats.total \u003e 0 ? (stats.interviewScheduled / stats.total) * 100 : 0}%&#96; }}\n                \u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-900\"\u003e{stats.interviewScheduled}\u003c/span\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n\n      \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6\"\u003e\n        \u003ch3 className=\"text-xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-6\"\u003ePerformance Metrics\u003c/h3\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"space-y-6\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2\"\u003eResponse Rate\u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-3\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"text-3xl font-light text-gray-900\"\u003e{stats.responseRate.toFixed(1)}%\u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\"\u003e\n                {stats.total \u003e 0 ? &#96;${stats.accepted + stats.rejected + stats.interviewScheduled} of ${stats.total} applications&#96; : 'No applications yet'}\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          \u003cdiv\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2\"\u003eAverage Response Time\u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-3\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"text-3xl font-light text-gray-900\"\u003e{stats.avgResponseTime.toFixed(1)}\u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\"\u003edays\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n          \n          \u003cdiv\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2\"\u003eSuccess Rate\u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-3\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"text-3xl font-light text-gray-900\"\u003e\n                {stats.total \u003e 0 ? ((stats.accepted + stats.interviewScheduled) / stats.total * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\"\u003e\n                {stats.total \u003e 0 ? &#96;${stats.accepted + stats.interviewScheduled} positive outcomes&#96; : 'No positive outcomes yet'}\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n\n  const renderSavedJobs = () =\u003e (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"p-6 border-b border-gray-100\"\u003e\n        \u003ch3 className=\"text-xl font-light text-gray-900\"\u003eSaved Jobs\u003c/h3\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \n      \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-12\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-6xl mb-4 opacity-20\"\u003e💾\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003ch3 className=\"text-xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003eSaved Jobs\u003c/h3\u003e\n        \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 mb-4\"\u003eSave interesting job postings to apply later.\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003cLink\n          to=\"/jobs\"\n          className=\"px-6 py-3 bg-blue-600 text-white font-light rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors\"\n        \u003e\n          Browse Jobs\n        \u003c/Link\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-8 py-16\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center mb-12\"\u003e\n          \u003ch1 className=\"text-4xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-4 tracking-tight\"\u003e\n            Application Dashboard\n          \u003c/h1\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-xl font-light text-gray-600 max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed\"\u003e\n            Track your job applications, view statistics, and manage your career progress.\n          \u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Tab Navigation */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-2 mb-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex space-x-2\"\u003e\n            {[\n              { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: '📊' },\n              { id: 'applications', label: 'Applications', icon: '📝' },\n              { id: 'analytics', label: 'Analytics', icon: '📈' },\n              { id: 'saved', label: 'Saved Jobs', icon: '💾' }\n            ].map((tab) =\u003e (\n              \u003cbutton\n                key={tab.id}\n                onClick={() =\u003e setActiveTab(tab.id as any)}\n                className={&#96;flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-lg font-light transition-all duration-300 ${\n                  activeTab === tab.id\n                    ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white'\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50'\n                }&#96;}\n              \u003e\n                \u003cspan className=\"mr-2\"\u003e{tab.icon}\u003c/span\u003e\n                {tab.label}\n              \u003c/button\u003e\n            ))}\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Content */}\n        {isLoading ? (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-12\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading dashboard...\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        ) : (\n          \u003c\u003e\n            {activeTab === 'overview' \u0026\u0026 renderOverview()}\n            {activeTab === 'applications' \u0026\u0026 renderApplications()}\n            {activeTab === 'analytics' \u0026\u0026 renderAnalytics()}\n            {activeTab === 'saved' \u0026\u0026 renderSavedJobs()}\n          \u003c/\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};\n\nexport default JobApplicationDashboard; ",

      "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobPosting, JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { JobApplicationService } from '../../utilities/jobApplicationService';\nimport { FileUploadService, UploadedFile } from '../../utilities/fileUploadService';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\n\ninterface JobApplicationFormData {\n  coverLetter: string;\n  expectedSalary?: number;\n  availabilityDate: string;\n  notes: string;\n  resumeFile: File | null;\n  resumeUploaded: UploadedFile | null;\n  attachments: File[];\n  attachmentsUploaded: UploadedFile[];\n}\n\nconst JobApplicationForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  \n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState\u003cJobApplicationFormData\u003e({\n    coverLetter: '',\n    expectedSalary: undefined,\n    availabilityDate: '',\n    notes: '',\n    resumeFile: null,\n    resumeUploaded: null,\n    attachments: [],\n    attachmentsUploaded: []\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId!));\n      \n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        setJob({\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting);\n      } else {\n        setError('Job not found');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      setError('Failed to load job details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof JobApplicationFormData, value: any) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      [field]: value\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (files: File[]) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      attachments: [...prev.attachments, ...files]\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =\u003e {\n    // All fields are now optional - just check if user is authenticated\n    if (!currentUser) {\n      setError('You must be logged in to apply');\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  };\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    \n    if (!validateForm() || !job) return;\n    \n    try {\n      setIsSubmitting(true);\n      setError(null);\n      \n      if (!currentUser) {\n        setError('You must be logged in to apply');\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      const userId = currentUser.uid;\n      \n      // Upload resume if not already uploaded\n      let resumeAttachment = null;\n      if (formData.resumeFile \u0026\u0026 !formData.resumeUploaded) {\n        const uploadedResume = await FileUploadService.uploadFile(\n          formData.resumeFile, \n          userId, \n          'resume'\n        );\n        resumeAttachment = {\n          id: uploadedResume.id,\n          name: uploadedResume.name,\n          url: uploadedResume.url,\n          type: 'resume' as const,\n          size: uploadedResume.size,\n          uploadedAt: uploadedResume.uploadedAt\n        };\n      } else if (formData.resumeUploaded) {\n        resumeAttachment = {\n          id: formData.resumeUploaded.id,\n          name: formData.resumeUploaded.name,\n          url: formData.resumeUploaded.url,\n          type: 'resume' as const,\n          size: formData.resumeUploaded.size,\n          uploadedAt: formData.resumeUploaded.uploadedAt\n        };\n      }\n      \n      // Upload attachments\n      const uploadedAttachments = [];\n      if (formData.attachments.length \u003e 0) {\n        const uploadedFiles = await FileUploadService.uploadMultipleFiles(\n          formData.attachments, \n          userId, \n          'attachments'\n        );\n        uploadedAttachments.push(...uploadedFiles);\n      }\n      \n      // Add previously uploaded attachments\n      uploadedAttachments.push(...formData.attachmentsUploaded);\n      \n      // Combine all attachments (resume + other attachments)\n      const allAttachments = [];\n      if (resumeAttachment) {\n        allAttachments.push(resumeAttachment);\n      }\n      allAttachments.push(...uploadedAttachments.map(file =\u003e ({\n        id: file.id,\n        name: file.name,\n        url: file.url,\n        type: 'other' as const,\n        size: file.size,\n        uploadedAt: file.uploadedAt\n      })));\n      \n      const applicationData = {\n        jobId: job.id,\n        applicantId: userId,\n        projectId: job.projectId || '', // Handle case where projectId is undefined\n        status: 'pending' as const,\n        coverLetter: formData.coverLetter || '',\n        expectedSalary: formData.expectedSalary,\n        availabilityDate: formData.availabilityDate || '',\n        notes: formData.notes || '',\n        resumeId: resumeAttachment?.id || '',\n        attachments: allAttachments\n      };\n      \n      const applicationId = await JobApplicationService.submitApplication(applicationData);\n      \n      setSuccess(true);\n      \n      // Redirect to success page after a short delay\n      setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n        navigate(&#96;/applications/${applicationId}/success&#96;);\n      }, 2000);\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error submitting application:', error);\n      setError('Failed to submit application. Please try again.');\n    } finally {\n      setIsSubmitting(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (!currentUser) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-6xl mb-4 opacity-20\"\u003e🔒\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003ch2 className=\"text-2xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003eAuthentication Required\u003c/h2\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 mb-4\"\u003ePlease log in to apply for this job.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003cbutton\n            onClick={() =\u003e navigate('/login')}\n            className=\"px-6 py-3 bg-blue-600 text-white font-medium rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors\"\n          \u003e\n            Go to Login\n          \u003c/button\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (isLoading) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading job details...\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (error \u0026\u0026 !job) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-6xl mb-4 opacity-20\"\u003e❌\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003ch2 className=\"text-2xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003eError\u003c/h2\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 mb-4\"\u003e{error}\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003cbutton\n            onClick={() =\u003e navigate('/jobs')}\n            className=\"px-6 py-3 bg-gray-900 text-white font-light rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors\"\n          \u003e\n            Back to Jobs\n          \u003c/button\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (success) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-6xl mb-4\"\u003e✅\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003ch2 className=\"text-2xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003e{t('applyJob.applicationSubmitted')}\u003c/h2\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 mb-4\"\u003eYour application has been successfully submitted.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"animate-pulse\"\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\"\u003eRedirecting to confirmation page...\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"max-w-4xl mx-auto px-8 py-16\"\u003e\n        {/* Header */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"mb-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cbutton\n            onClick={() =\u003e navigate(-1)}\n            className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 mb-4 transition-colors\"\n          \u003e\n            ← {t('applyJob.backToJob')}\n          \u003c/button\u003e\n          \n          \u003ch1 className=\"text-3xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003e\n            {t('applyJob.applyFor')} {job?.title}\n          \u003c/h1\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600\"\u003e\n            {t('applyJob.completeApplication')}\n          \u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Job Summary */}\n        {job \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6 mb-8\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-start justify-between mb-4\"\u003e\n              \u003cdiv\u003e\n                \u003ch3 className=\"text-xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003e{job.title}\u003c/h3\u003e\n                \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600 mb-1\"\u003e{job.department} • {job.location}\u003c/p\u003e\n                {job.salary \u0026\u0026 (\n                  \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600\"\u003e\n                    ${job.salary.min.toLocaleString()} - ${job.salary.max.toLocaleString()}\n                  \u003c/p\u003e\n                )}\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n              {job.isUrgent \u0026\u0026 (\n                \u003cspan className=\"px-3 py-1 bg-red-100 text-red-800 text-xs font-medium rounded-full\"\u003e\n                  {t('applyJob.urgent')}\n                \u003c/span\u003e\n              )}\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n            \n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-2\"\u003e\n              {(job.tags || []).slice(0, 5).map(tag =\u003e (\n                \u003cspan key={tag} className=\"px-3 py-1 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 text-xs font-medium rounded-full\"\u003e\n                  {tag}\n                \u003c/span\u003e\n              ))}\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n\n        {/* Application Form */}\n        \u003cform onSubmit={handleSubmit} className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-8\"\u003e\n          {error \u0026\u0026 (\n            \u003cdiv className=\"mb-6 p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg\"\u003e\n              \u003cp className=\"text-red-800\"\u003e{error}\u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          )}\n\n          {/* Cover Letter */}\n          \u003cdiv className=\"mb-8\"\u003e\n            \u003clabel className=\"block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\"\u003e\n              {t('applyJob.coverLetter')}\n            \u003c/label\u003e\n            \u003ctextarea\n              value={formData.coverLetter}\n              onChange={(e) =\u003e handleInputChange('coverLetter', e.target.value)}\n              placeholder={t('applyJob.coverLetterPlaceholder')}\n              className=\"w-full h-48 p-4 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg focus:border-gray-400 focus:outline-none resize-none font-light\"\n            /\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2\"\u003e\n              {t('applyJob.coverLetterNote')}\n            \u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n\n          {/* Expected Salary */}\n          \u003cdiv className=\"mb-8\"\u003e\n            \u003clabel className=\"block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\"\u003e\n              {t('applyJob.expectedSalary')}\n            \u003c/label\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"text-gray-500\"\u003e$\u003c/span\u003e\n              \u003cinput\n                type=\"number\"\n                value={formData.expectedSalary || ''}\n                onChange={(e) =\u003e handleInputChange('expectedSalary', e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : undefined)}\n                placeholder={t('applyJob.expectedSalaryPlaceholder')}\n                className=\"flex-1 p-3 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg focus:border-gray-400 focus:outline-none font-light\"\n                min=\"0\"\n              /\u003e\n              \u003cspan className=\"text-gray-500\"\u003e{t('applyJob.perYear')}\u003c/span\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2\"\u003e\n              {t('applyJob.salaryNote')}\n            \u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n\n          {/* Availability Date */}\n          \u003cdiv className=\"mb-8\"\u003e\n            \u003clabel className=\"block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\"\u003e\n              {t('applyJob.availabilityDate')}\n            \u003c/label\u003e\n            \u003cinput\n              type=\"date\"\n              value={formData.availabilityDate}\n              onChange={(e) =\u003e handleInputChange('availabilityDate', e.target.value)}\n              className=\"w-full p-3 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg focus:border-gray-400 focus:outline-none font-light\"\n            /\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n\n console.error('Error loading application details:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getStatusTimeline = () =\u003e {\n    if (!application) return [];\n\n completed: true\n      });\n    }\n\n    return timeline;\n  };\n\n  const getStatusColor = (status: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'pending': return 'bg-yellow-100 };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {\n       "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplicationService } from department?: string;\n  location?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  postedAt?: any;\n  postedById: string;\n}\n\ninterface ApplicationWithJob {\n  application: JobApplication;\n  job: JobPostingSummary | null;\n}\n\nconst ApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cApplicationWithJob[]\u003e([]);\n  const [filteredApplications, setFilteredApplications] = useState\u003cApplicationWithJob[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  \n  // Filter and sort state\n  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('all');\n  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('');\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = pending: 0,\n    reviewed: 0,\n    shortlisted: 0,\n    interviewed: 0,\n    hired: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    withdrawn: 0\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDocs(query(\n            collection(db, 'jobPostings'),\n            where('__name__', '==', app.jobId)\n          ));\n          \n          if (!jobDoc.empty) {\n            const jobData = jobDoc.docs[0].data();\n            return {\n              application: app,\n              job: {\n                id: jobDoc.docs[0].id,\n                title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n                companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n                department: jobData.department || '',\n                location: jobData.location || '',\n                status: jobData.status || '',\n                postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n                postedById: jobDoc.docs[0].id, // Assuming jobId is the document ID\n              } as JobPostingSummary\n            };\n          }\n          \n          return { application: app, job: null };\n        }));\n        \n        setApplications(jobs);\n        \n        // Calculate stats\n        const newStats = {\n          total: jobs.length,\n          pending: jobs.filter(j =\u003e j.application.status === 'pending').length,\n          reviewed: jobs.filter(j =\u003e j.application.status === 'reviewed').length,\n          shortlisted: jobs.filter(j =\u003e j.application.status === 'shortlisted').length,\n          interviewed: jobs.filter(j =\u003e j.application.status === 'interviewed').length,\n          hired: jobs.filter(j =\u003e j.application.status === 'hired').length,\n          rejected: jobs.filter(j =\u003e j.application.status === 'rejected').length,\n          withdrawn: jobs.filter(j =\u003e j.application.status === 'withdrawn').length\n        };\n        setStats(newStats);\n        \n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applications:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applications');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);\n\n  // Filter and sort applications\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    let filtered = applications;\n\n    // Status filter\n    if (statusFilter !== 'all') {\n      filtered = filtered.filter(app =\u003e app.application.status === statusFilter);\n    }\n\n    // Search filter\n    if (searchTerm) {\n      filtered = filtered.filter(app =\u003e \n        app.job?.title?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||\n        app.job?.companyName?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||\n        app.job?.department?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||\n        app.job?.location?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Sort\n    filtered.sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n      let aValue: any, bValue: any;\n      \n      switch (sortBy) {\n        case 'appliedAt':\n          aValue = a.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n          bValue = b.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n          break;\n        case 'company':\n          aValue = a.job?.companyName || '';\n          bValue = b.job?.companyName || '';\n          break;\n        case 'title':\n          aValue = a.job?.title || '';\n          bValue = b.job?.title || '';\n          break;\n        case 'status':\n          aValue = a.application.status;\n          bValue = b.application.status;\n          break;\n        default:\n          aValue = a.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n          bValue = b.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n      }\n\n      if (sortOrder === 'asc') {\n        return aValue \u003e bValue ? 1 : -1;\n      } else {\n        return aValue \u003c bValue ? 1 : -1;\n      }\n    });\n\n    setFilteredApplications(filtered);\n  }, [applications, statusFilter, searchTerm, sortBy, sortOrder]);\n\n  const getStatusColor = (status: string) =\u003e {\n    const colors = {\n      pending: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800',\n      reviewed: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800',\n      shortlisted: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800',\n      interviewed: 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800',\n      hired: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800',\n      rejected: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800',\n      withdrawn: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'\n    };\n    return colors[status as keyof typeof colors] || 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n  };\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 py-12 px-4 md:px-8\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"max-w-7xl mx-auto\"\u003e\n        {/* Header */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"mb-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv\u003e\n applications\u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cLink \n              to=\"/applications/analytics\" \n              className=\"px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg            \u003cdiv className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900\"\u003e{stats.total}\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003eTotal\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\" className=\"text-center p-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600\"\u003e{stats.pending}\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003ePending\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\" className=\"text-center p-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600\"\u003e{stats.reviewed}\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003eReviewed\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\" className=\"text-center p-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv \u003c/Card\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\" className=\"text-center p-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-600\"\u003e{stats.interviewed}\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003eInterviewed\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\" className=\"text-center p-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-green-600\"\u003e{stats.hired}\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003eHired\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\" className=\"text-center p-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-red-600\"\u003e{stats.rejected}\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003eRejected\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n          \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\" className=\"text-center p-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-gray-600\"\u003e{stats.withdrawn}\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-sm text-gray-600\"\u003eWithdrawn\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/Card\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Filters and Search */}\n        \u003cCard variant=\"elevated\" className=\"mb-6\"\u003e\n          \u003cCardBody className=\"p-6\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4\"\u003e\n              {/* Search */}\n              \u003cdiv className=\"flex-1\"\u003e\n                \u003cdiv className=\"relative\"\u003e\n                  \u003cSearch className=\"absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 w-4 h-4\" /\u003e\n                  \u003cinput\n                    type=\"text\"\n                    placeholder=\"Search jobs, companies, or locations...\"\n                    value={searchTerm}\n                    onChange={(e) =\u003e setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}\n                    className=\"w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent\"\n                  /\u003e\n                \u003c/div\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n\n              {/* Status Filter */}\n              \u003cdiv className=\"w-full md:w-48\"\u003e\n                \u003cSelect\n                  value={statusFilter}\n                  onChange={(e) =\u003e setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}\n                  options={[\n                    { value: 'all', label: 'All Statuses' },\n                    { value: 'pending', label: 'Pending' },\n                    { value: 'reviewed', label: 'Reviewed' },\n                    { value: 'shortlisted', label: 'Shortlisted' },\n                    { value: 'interviewed', label: 'Interviewed' },\n                    { value: 'hired', label: 'Hired' },\n                    { value: 'rejected', label: 'Rejected' },\n                    { value: 'withdrawn', label: 'Withdrawn' }\n                  ]}\n                /\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n\n              {/* Sort */}\n              \u003cdiv className=\"w-full md:w-48\"\u003e\n                \u003cSelect\n                  value={sortBy}\n                  onChange={(e) =\u003e setSortBy(e.target.value)}\n                  options={[\n                    { value: 'appliedAt', label:                 ]}\n                /\u003e\n              \u003c/div\u003e\n\n              {/* Sort Order */}\n              \u003cButton\n                variant=\"outline\"\n                onClick={() =\u003e setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc')}\n                className=\"w-full md:w-auto\"\n              \u003e\n                \u003cArrowUpDown className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" /\u003e\n                {sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'A-Z' : 'Z-A'}\n              \u003c/Button\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003c/CardBody\u003e\n        \u003c/Card\u003e\n\n        {/* Applications List */}\n        {isLoading ? (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-12\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading applications...\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        ) : filteredApplications.length === 0 ? (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-12\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-6xl mb-4 opacity-20\"\u003e📝\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003ch3 className=\"text-xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003eNo applications found\u003c/h3\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600\"\u003e\n              {applications.length === 0 \n                ? \"You haven't applied to any jobs yet.\" \n                : \"No applications match your current filters.\"}\n            \u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        ) : (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6\"\u003e\n            {filteredApplications.map(({ application, job }) =\u003e {\n              const enhancedStatus: ApplicationStatus = {\n                status: application.status || 'pending',\n                lastUpdated: application.lastUpdated?.toDate(),\n                timeline: {\n                  applied: application.appliedAt?.toDate() || new Date(),\n                  reviewed: application.reviewedAt?.toDate(),\n                  shortlisted: application.reviewedAt?.toDate(),\n                  interviewed: application.interviewScheduled?.toDate(),\n                  decision: application.lastUpdated?.toDate(),\n                },\n                notes: application.notes,\n                nextStep: application.interviewNotes\n              };\n\n              return (\n                \u003cCard key={application.id} variant=\"elevated\" hoverable\u003e\n                  \u003cCardBody className=\"p-6\"\u003e\n                    \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-start justify-between mb-4\"\u003e\n                      \u003cdiv className=\"flex-1\"\u003e\n                        \u003cCardTitle className=\"text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003e\n                          \u003cLink to={job ? &#96;/jobs/${job.id}&#96; : '#'} className=\"hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors\"\u003e\n                            {job?.title || 'Untitled Job'}\n                          \u003c/Link\u003e\n                        \u003c/CardTitle\u003e\n                        \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-gray-600 mb-3\"\u003e\n                          {job?.companyName \u0026\u0026 (\n                            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-1\"\u003e\n                              \u003cBuilding className=\"w-4 h-4\" /\u003e\n                              \u003cspan\u003e{job.companyName}\u003c/span\u003e\n                            \u003c/div\u003e\n                          )}\n                          {job?.location \u0026\u0026 (\n                            \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-1\"\u003e\n                              \u003cMapPin className=\"w-4 h-4\" /\u003e\n                              \u003cspan\u003e{job.location}\u003c/span\u003e\n                            \u003c/div\u003e\n                          )}\n                        \u003c/div\u003e\n                      \u003c/div\u003e\n                    \u003c/div\u003e\n\n                    {/* Enhanced Status Tracking */}\n                    \u003cApplicationStatusBadge \n                      status={enhancedStatus} \n                      showProgress={true}\n                      className=\"mb-4\"\n                    /\u003e\n\n                    \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-2 pt-4 border-t border-gray-100\"\u003e\n                      \u003cLink \n                        to={job ? &#96;/jobs/${job.id}&#96; : '#'} \n                        className=\"flex-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-blue-600 text-white font-light rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors text-center\"\n                      \u003e\n                        View Job\n                      \u003c/Link\u003e\n                      \u003cLink \n                        to={&#96;/applications/${application.id}&#96;} \n                        className=\"flex-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-gray-900 text-white font-light rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors text-center\"\n                      \u003e\n                        View Application\n                      \u003c/Link\u003e\n                    \u003c/div\u003e\n                  \u003c/CardBody\u003e\n                \u003c/Card\u003e\n              );\n            })}\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};\n\nexport default ApplicationDashboard; ",

      "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, collection, query, where, getDocs } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobPosting, JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { JobApplicationService } from '../../utilities/jobApplicationService';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\n\nconst JobApplicationsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [applicantProfiles, setApplicantProfiles] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'all' | 'pending' | 'reviewed' | 'shortlisted' | 'hired' | 'rejected'\u003e('all');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobAndApplications();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobAndApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!jobId) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // Load job details\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId));\n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        const jobData = {\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting;\n        setJob(jobData);\n        \n        // Check if current user is the job poster\n        if (jobData.postedById !== currentUser?.uid) {\n          toast.error('You can only view applications for jobs you posted');\n          return;\n        }\n      } else {\n        toast.error('Job not found');\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // Load applications\n      const jobApplications = await JobApplicationService.getJobApplications(jobId);\n      setApplications(jobApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch applicant profiles\n      const applicantIds = jobApplications.map(app =\u003e app.applicantId);\n      const profilesMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      \n      for (const applicantId of applicantIds) {\n        try {\n          const profileQuery = query(collection(db, 'crewProfiles'), where('uid', '==', applicantId));\n          const profileSnapshot = await getDocs(profileQuery);\n          if (!profileSnapshot.empty) {\n            const profileData = profileSnapshot.docs[0].data();\n            profilesMap[applicantId] = {\n              uid: profileData.uid || applicantId,\n              name: profileData.name || 'Unknown',\n              username: profileData.username || profileData.name?.toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, '') || 'unknown',\n              bio: profileData.bio || '',\n              jobTitles: profileData.jobTitles || [],\n            };\n          } else {\n            // Fallback for missing profile\n            profilesMap[applicantId] = {\n              uid: applicantId,\n              name: 'Unknown',\n              username: 'unknown',\n              bio: '',\n              jobTitles: [],\n            };\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('Error fetching profile for applicantId:', applicantId, error);\n          profilesMap[applicantId] = {\n            uid: applicantId,\n            name: 'Unknown',\n            username: 'unknown',\n            bio: '',\n            jobTitles: [],\n          };\n        }\n      }\n      setApplicantProfiles(profilesMap);\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job and applications:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to load applications');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getStatusColor = (status: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'pending': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';\n      case 'reviewed': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';\n      case 'shortlisted': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'interviewed': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800';\n      case 'hired': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'rejected': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';\n      case 'withdrawn': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getStatusIcon = (status: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'pending': return '⏳';\n      case 'reviewed': return '👁️';\n      case 'shortlisted': return '⭐';\n      case 'interviewed': return '📅';\n      case 'hired': return '✅';\n      case 'rejected': return '❌';\n      case 'withdrawn': return '↩️';\n      default: return '📋';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (date: any) =\u003e {\n    if (!date) return 'N/A';\n    const dateObj = date?.toDate ? date.toDate() : new Date(date);\n    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString();\n  };\n\n  const filteredApplications = applications.filter(app =\u003e {\n    if (activeTab === 'all') return true;\n    return app.status === activeTab;\n  });\n\n  const stats = {\n    total: applications.length,\n    pending: applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'pending').length,\n    reviewed: hover:text-blue-700\"\u003e\n              Back to Jobs\n            \u003c/Link\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-8 py-16\"\u003e\n        {/* Header */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"mb-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv\u003e\n              \u003ch1 className=\"text-4xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2 tracking-tight\"\u003e\n {applications.length} applications\n              \u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cLink\n              to={&#96;/jobs/${job.id}&#96;}\n              className=\"px-6 \u003c/div\u003e\n\n        {/* Stats */}\n        \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-7 gap-4 mb-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-4 text-center\"\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-2xl font-light text-gray-900\"\u003e{stats.total}\u003c/p\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-sm       "contents": "import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { collection, query, where, getDocs, doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { JobApplicationService } from '../../utilities/jobApplicationService';\nimport ApplicationStatusBadge, { ApplicationStatus } from './ApplicationStatusBadge';\nimport Card, { CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '../ui/Card';\n\ninterface JobPostingSummary {\n  id: string;\n  title: string;\n  companyName?: string;\n  department?: string;\n  location?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  postedAt?: any;\n}\n\nconst AppliedJobsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [appliedJobs, setAppliedJobs] = useState\u003cArray\u003c{ application: JobApplication; job: JobPostingSummary | null }\u003e\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    \n    // Subscribe to real-time updates for user applications\n    const unsubscribe = JobApplicationService.subscribeToUserApplications(currentUser.uid, async (applications) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const jobs = await Promise.all(applications.map(async (app) =\u003e {\n          if (!app.jobId) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', app.jobId));\n          if (!jobDoc.exists()) return { application: app, job: null };\n          const jobData = jobDoc.data();\n          return {\n            application: app,\n            job: {\n              id: jobDoc.id,\n              title: jobData.title || 'Untitled Job',\n              companyName: jobData.companyName || jobData.company || '',\n              department: jobData.department || '',\n              location: jobData.location || '',\n              status: jobData.status || '',\n              postedAt: jobData.postedAt || null,\n            } as JobPostingSummary\n          };\n        }));\n        setAppliedJobs(jobs);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching applied jobs:', error);\n        toast.error('Failed to load applied jobs');\n      } finally {\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // Cleanup subscription on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (unsubscribe) {\n        unsubscribe();\n      }\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 py-12 px-4 md:px-8\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"max-w-4xl mx-auto\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"mb-8 flex items-center justify-between\"\u003e\n          \u003ch1 className=\"text-3xl font-light text-gray-900\"\u003eJobs You've Applied To\u003c/h1\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-4\"\u003e\n            \u003cLink to=\"/applications/dashboard\" className=\"text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm\"\u003e\n              View Dashboard\n            \u003c/Link\u003e\n            \u003cLink to=\"/jobs\" className=\"text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm\"\u003e← Back to Job Search\u003c/Link\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n        {isLoading ? (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-12\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-gray-900 mx-auto mb-4\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-lg font-light text-gray-600\"\u003eLoading applied jobs...\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        ) : appliedJobs.length === 0 ? (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-12\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv className=\"text-6xl mb-4 opacity-20\"\u003e📝\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003ch3 className=\"text-xl font-light text-gray-900 mb-2\"\u003eNo applications yet\u003c/h3\u003e\n            \u003cp className=\"text-gray-600\"\u003eJobs you apply to will appear here.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        ) : (\n          \u003cdiv className=\"grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6\"\u003e\n            {appliedJobs.map(({ application, job }) =\u003e {\n              // Create enhanced status object\n              const enhancedStatus: ApplicationStatus = {\n                status: application.status || 'pending',\n                lastUpdated: application.lastUpdated?.toDate(),\n                timeline: {\n                  applied: application.appliedAt?.toDate() || new Date(),\n                  reviewed: application.reviewedAt?.toDate(),\n                  shortlisted: application.reviewedAt?.toDate(), // Use reviewedAt for shortlisted\n                  interviewed: application.interviewScheduled?.toDate(),\n                  decision: application.lastUpdated?.toDate(),\n                },\n                notes: application.notes,\n                nextStep: application.interviewNotes\n              };\n\n              return (\n                \u003cCard key={application.id} variant=\"elevated\" hoverable className=\"flex flex-col\"\u003e\n                  \u003cCardBody className=\"p-6 flex flex-col justify-between\"\u003e\n                    \u003cdiv className=\"mb-4\"\u003e\n                      \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-start justify-between mb-3\"\u003e\n                        \u003cCardTitle className=\"text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors truncate\"\u003e\n                          \u003cLink to={job ? &#96;/jobs/${job.id}&#96; : '#'} title={job?.title}\u003e\n                            {job?.title || 'Untitled Job'}\n                          \u003c/Link\u003e\n                        \u003c/CardTitle\u003e\n                      \u003c/div\u003e\n                      \n                      \u003cCardDescription className=\"text-gray-600 mb-3\"\u003e\n                        {job?.companyName} • {job?.department} • {job?.location}\n                      \u003c/CardDescription\u003e\n\n                      {/* Enhanced Status Tracking */}\n                      \u003cApplicationStatusBadge \n                        status={enhancedStatus} \n                        showProgress={true}\n                        className=\"mb-4\"\n                      /\u003e\n                    \u003c/div\u003e\n\n                    \u003cCardFooter className=\"flex items-center gap-2 pt-4 border-t border-gray-100\"\u003e\n                      \u003cLink \n                        to={job ? &#96;/jobs/${job.id}&#96; : '#'} \n                        className=\"flex-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-blue-600 text-white font-light rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors text-center\"\n                      \u003e\n                        View Job\n                      \u003c/Link\u003e\n                      \u003cLink \n                        to={&#96;/applications/${application.id}&#96;} \n                        className=\"flex-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-gray-900 text-white font-light rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors text-center\"\n                      \u003e\n                        View Application\n                      \u003c/Link\u003e\n                    \u003c/CardFooter\u003e\n                  \u003c/CardBody\u003e\n                \u003c/Card\u003e\n              );\n            })}\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        )}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};\n\nexport default AppliedJobsPage; ",

      "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { collection, query, where, orderBy, getDocs, doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { JobPosting, JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { Link } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { JobApplicationService } from '../../utilities/jobApplicationService';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';\n\ninterface JobPosterStats {\n  totalJobs: number;\n  activeJobs: number;\n  totalApplications: number;\n  pendingApplications: number;\n  avgApplicationsPerJob: number;\n  totalViews: number;\n}\n\ninterface JobWithApplications extends JobPosting {\n  applications: JobApplication[];\n  applicantCount: number;\n}\n\nconst JobPosterDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [postedJobs, setPostedJobs] = useState\u003cJobWithApplications[]\u003e([]);\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cJobPosterStats\u003e({\n    totalJobs: 0,\n    activeJobs: 0,\n    totalApplications: 0,\n    pendingApplications: 0,\n    avgApplicationsPerJob: 0,\n    totalViews: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'jobs' | 'applications' | 'analytics'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (currentUser) {\n      loadPostedJobs();\n    }\n  }, [currentUser]);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [postedJobs]);\n\n  const loadPostedJobs = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // Get jobs posted by current user (using postedById)\n      const jobsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'jobPostings'),\n        where('postedById', '==', currentUser.uid),\n        orderBy('postedAt', 'desc')\n      );\n      \n      const jobsSnapshot = await getDocs(jobsQuery);\n      const jobsData: JobWithApplications[] = [];\n      \n      // For each job, get the applications\n      for (const jobDoc of jobsSnapshot.docs) {\n        const jobData = {\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting;\n        \n        // Get applications for this job\n        const applications = await JobApplicationService.getJobApplications(jobDoc.id);\n        \n        jobsData.push({\n          ...jobData,\n          applications,\n          applicantCount: applications.length\n        });\n      }\n      \n      setPostedJobs(jobsData);\n      console.log('Loaded posted jobs:', jobsData.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading posted jobs:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to load posted jobs');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const calculateStats = () =\u003e {\n    const totalJobs = postedJobs.length;\n    const activeJobs = postedJobs.filter(job =\u003e job.status === 'active' || job.status === 'published').length;\n    const totalApplications = postedJobs.reduce((sum, job) =\u003e sum + job.applicantCount, 0);\n    const pendingApplications = postedJobs.reduce((sum, job) =\u003e \n      sum + job.applications.filter(app =\u003e app.status === 'pending').length, 0\n    );\n    const avgApplicationsPerJob = totalJobs \u003e 0 ? totalApplications / totalJobs : 0;\n    const totalViews = postedJobs.reduce((sum, job) =\u003e sum + (job.views || 0), 0);\n\n    setStats({\n      totalJobs,\n      activeJobs,\n      totalApplications,\n      pendingApplications,\n      avgApplicationsPerJob,\n      totalViews\n    });\n  };\n\n  const getStatusColor = (status: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'active':\n      case 'published': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'draft': return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n      case 'closed': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';\n      default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getStatusIcon = (status: string)    '6m': 180,\n      '1y': 365\n    };\n    const cutoffDate = new Date(now.getTime() - timeRangeDays[timeRange] * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n    \n    const filteredApplications = applications.filter(app =\u003e {\n      const appliedDate = app.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n      return appliedDate \u003e= cutoffDate;\n    });\n\n    // Status breakdown\n    const statusBreakdown: (statusBreakdown[status] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n\n    // Success rate (hired / total)\n    const totalApplications = filteredApplications.length;\n    const hiredCount = statusBreakdown['hired'] || 0;\n    const successRate = totalApplications \u003e 0 ? (hiredCount / totalApplications) * 100 : 0;\n\n    // Average response time\n    const responseTimes: number[] = [];\n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      if (app.application.reviewedAt \u0026\u0026 app.application.appliedAt) {\n        const appliedDate = app.application.appliedAt.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n        const reviewedDate = app.application.reviewedAt.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n        const responseTime = (reviewedDate.getTime() - appliedDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24); // days\n        if (responseTime \u003e 0) {\n          responseTimes.push(responseTime);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n    const averageResponseTime = responseTimes.length \u003e 0 \n      ? responseTimes.reduce((sum, time) =\u003e sum + time, 0) / responseTimes.length \n      : 0;\n\n    // Monthly trends\n    const monthlyData: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      const appliedDate = app.application.appliedAt?.toDate?.() || new Date(0);\n      const monthKey = &#96;${appliedDate.getFullYear()}-${String(appliedDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}&#96;;\n      monthlyData[monthKey] = (monthlyData[monthKey] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n    const monthlyTrends = Object.entries(monthlyData)\n      .map(([month, count]) =\u003e ({ month, count }))\n      .sort((a, b) =\u003e a.month.localeCompare(b.month));\n\n    // Top companies\n    const companyCounts: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      const company = app.job?.companyName || 'Unknown';\n      companyCounts[company] = (companyCounts[company] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n    const topCompanies = Object.entries(companyCounts)\n      .map(([company, count]) =\u003e ({ company, count }))\n      .sort((a, b) =\u003e b.count - appliedDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);\n        if (responseTime \u003e 0) {\n          if (!statusResponseTimes[status]) statusResponseTimes[status] = [];\n          statusResponseTimes[status].push(responseTime);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    Object.entries(statusResponseTimes).forEach(([status, times]) =\u003e {\n      responseTimeByStatus[status] = times.reduce((sum, time) =\u003e sum + time, 0) / times.length;\n    });\n\n    // Conversion rates\n    const conversionRates: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    const statusTransitions: Record\u003cstring, number\u003e = {};\n    \n    filteredApplications.forEach(app =\u003e {\n      const status = app.application.status || 'pending';\n      statusTransitions[status] = (statusTransitions[status] || 0) + 1;\n    });\n\n    const total = Object.values(statusTransitions).reduce((sum, count) =\u003e sum + count, 0);\n    Object.entries(statusTransitions).forEach(([status, count]) =\u003e {\n      conversionRates[status] = total \u003e 0 ? (count / total) * 100 : 0;\n    });\n\n    return {\n      totalApplications,\n      successRate,\n      averageResponseTime,\n      statusBreakdown,\n      monthlyTrends,\n      topCompanies,\n         "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { doc, getDoc, collection, query, where, getDocs, updateDoc, addDoc, serverTimestamp, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { JobApplication } from '../../types/JobApplication';\nimport { FileUploadService } from '../../utilities/fileUploadService';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Button } from '../ui/Button';\nimport Card from '../ui/Card';\nimport ApplicationMessaging from './ApplicationMessaging';\nimport { \n  Users, \n  MessageSquare, \n  CheckCircle, \n  XCircle, \n  Star, \n  Heart, \n  Eye, \n  Calendar,\n  MapPin,\n  DollarSign,\n  Briefcase,\n  Clock,\n  Phone,\n  Mail,\n  ExternalLink,\n  Filter,\n  Search,\n  MoreHorizontal,\n  Send,\n  User,\n  Award,\n  TrendingUp,\n  Download,\n  FileText,\n  Paperclip\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface ApplicantProfile {\n  uid: string;\n  name: string;\n  username: string;\n  bio: string;\n  jobTitles: string[];\n  experience: string;\n  location: string;\n  skills: string[];\n  availability: string;\n  expectedSalary?: number;\n  portfolio?: string;\n  phone?: string;\n  email?: string;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "const JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {"

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationDashboard: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [jobDetails, setJobDetails] = useState\u003c{[key: string]: any}\u003e({});\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cApplicationStats\u003e({\n    total: 0,\n    pending: 0,\n    accepted: 0,\n    rejected: 0,\n    interviewScheduled: 0,\n    responseRate: 0,\n    avgResponseTime: 0\n  });\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'overview' | 'applications' | 'analytics' | 'saved'\u003e('overview');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadApplications();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    calculateStats();\n  }, [applications]);\n\n  const loadApplications = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    \n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const userApplications = await JobApplicationService.getUserApplications(currentUser.uid);\n      setApplications(userApplications);\n      \n      // Fetch job details for each application\n      const jobDetailsMap: {[key: string]: any} = {};\n      for (const application of userApplications) {\n        if (application.jobId) {\n          try {\n            const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', application.jobId));\n            if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n              jobDetailsMap[application.jobId] = {\n                id: jobDoc.id,\n                ...jobDoc.data()\n              };\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Error fetching job details for jobId:', application.jobId, error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      setJobDetails(jobDetailsMap);\n      \n      console.log('Loaded applications:', userApplications.length);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading applications:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",
